 Som frontendutvecklare kommer du att utveckla och vidareutveckla en gemensam frontendplattform med fokus på microfrontends, Web Components och återanvändbara komponentbibliotek. Du arbetar med moderna frontendtekniker, bidrar till arkitektur och tekniska vägval samt utvecklar verksamhetskritiska applikationer. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med utvecklingsteam och UX, där du förväntas skapa skalbara, hållbara och användarvänliga lösningar i en dynamisk miljö.
   

  

**Hos oss kommer du att**
* Utveckla och vidareutveckla frontendplattformar och gemensamma bibliotek.
* Bygga moderna och återanvändbara UI-komponenter.
* Arbeta med microfrontends och Web Components i stor skala.
* Förbättra utvecklarupplevelsen genom verktyg, builders och templates.
* Samarbeta tätt med andra team och UX för att skapa hållbara och användarvänliga lösningar.
* Stötta utvecklare i användningen av gemensamma plattformar och komponenter.
* Delta i tekniska vägval och kontinuerligt utvärdera nya tekniker och arbetssätt.
* Arbeta med både nyutveckling, förbättringar och förvaltning av verksamhetskritiska applikationer.
* Delta i ett rullande schema för support och beredskap.


**Tech stack**
* HTML
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* Web Components
* Vue & Svelte
* Microfrontend-arkitektur
* SystemJS
* Vite, Rollup & Esbuild
* SCSS & CSS
* Storybook


**Varför denna roll?**
 Hos oss får du möjlighet att påverka frontendplattformen som många andra team bygger vidare på. Du blir en del av ett tekniskt kunnigt team där arkitektur, kvalitet och utvecklarupplevelse står i fokus.
   

  

 Här finns stora möjligheter att driva förbättringar, testa nya idéer och arbeta med modern frontendutveckling i stor skala – samtidigt som du får en central roll med stort samarbete och många kontaktytor i organisationen.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som:**
* Har flera års erfarenhet av frontendutveckling.
* Har goda kunskaper inom JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML samt Vue (eller motsvarande frontendramverk).
* Har erfarenhet av microfrontend-arkitektur och arbete med Web Components.
* Har arbetat med design systems och komponentbibliotek.
* Har ett starkt fokus på att skapa hållbara och skalbara lösningar.
* Har ett intresse för arkitektur och komponentdriven utveckling.


**Vi tror också att du:**
* Trivs i en central roll med många kontaktytor och ett högt samarbetsinslag.
* Ser värdet i gemensamma diskussioner och bidrar till att hitta de bästa lösningarna tillsammans med teamet.
* Har förmåga att hantera flera parallella initiativ och trivs i en dynamisk vardag.
* Är nyfiken på nya tekniker och drivs av att kontinuerligt förbättra arbetssätt och plattformar.


**Extra meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av tillgänglighetsarbete (WCAG och inkluderande gränssnitt).
* Erfarenhet av AI-relaterade lösningar eller AI-drivna utvecklingsverktyg.
* Kunskap inom Azure DevOps och infrastruktur.

title: .NET-utvecklare
description:
Tech with a Human Touch
 



 ANIMARUM söker en senior .NET-utvecklare som vill jobba som expertkonsult. Här arbetar vi med målmedveten innovation och ser teknik som något som stärker både individer och organisationer, inte bara som ett verktyg.
 







 Om rollen
 



 I rollen som senior .NET utvecklare kommer du att:
 



  




* Designa och utveckla robusta och skalbara lösningar i .NET-plattformen med fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet och hög prestanda.



  




* Arbeta med moderna ramverk och tekniker som ASP.NET Core, C#, Entity Framework och Azure.



  




* Arbeta nära kunder och interna tvärfunktionella team, förstå behov och mål, och ta fram lösningar som skapar verkligt värde.






* Kunna vara med och driva hela leveranskedjan — från första möte och strategi till implementation, driftsättning och testning.



  




* Ansvara för teknisk kvalitet, systemarkitektur och pålitlighet i lösningar som kontinuerligt förbättras och utvecklas.



  




* Dela kunskap, coacha kollegor och bidra till att höja teamets utvecklingspraxis genom feedback, mentorskap och gemensamt lärande. Transparens, öppen kommunikation och samarbete är kärnan i vår arbetsmetod.



  





**Vi söker dig som har:** 



* Minst 10 års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, varav flera år med .NET och C#.



  




* Djup förståelse för molntjänster (AWS, Azure och/eller GCP) samt erfarenhet av Infrastructure-as-Code (ex. ARM Templates, Bicep eller Terraform)



  




* Kunskap inom prestanda, säkerhet och tillförlitlighet.



  




* Mycket god kommunikationsförmåga i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska.






* Förmåga att ta ansvar för helheten i tekniska leveranser.



  




* En vilja att bidra till ett kreativt och inkluderande arbetsklimat.



  




* Erfarenhet och/eller en öppenhet för att jobba Fullstack när det behövs.



  










**Varför ANIMARUM** 




**På ANIMARUM handlar det inte bara om jobbet – det handlar om att vara en del av ett team där alla stöttar varandra. Vi tror på ett människocentrerat förhållningssätt.** 




  





**Vi är ett team som verkligen bryr oss om varandra och strävar efter att skapa en arbetsplats där alla kan växa och lyckas.** 









**Möjligheter att växa** 









**Balans mellan arbete och fritid** 




**Vi förstår att livet inte bara handlar om arbete. Vi stöttar dig i att hitta den perfekta balansen mellan karriär och privatliv.** 









**Förmåner som gör livet enklare** 




**På ANIMARUM vill vi att våra medarbetare ska blomstra – inte bara på jobbet, utan i livet. Därför erbjuder vi en rad förmåner som gör livet lite enklare:** 









**Friskvårdsbidrag** 




**Stärk ditt välmående med vårt friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 SEK varje år. Oavsett om det gäller gymkort, massage eller något annat som får dig att må bra – det är ditt att använda!** 









**Företagsbil eller cykel** 




**Res med stil med möjlighet till företagsbil eller företagscykel – perfekt för din dagliga pendling eller helgäventyr.** 









**Bruttolöneavdrag** 




**Vi erbjuder bruttolöneavdrag så att du kan göra smarta ekonomiska val för din framtid.** 









**SL-kort** 




**Vi gör pendlingen enkel med ett SL-kort, så du slipper tänka på biljetter och kan fokusera på att komma dit du behöver.** 









**Att få livet att fungera** 




**Vi vet att det kan vara svårt att balansera arbete och privatliv, därför samarbetar vi med företag som erbjuder rabatterade tjänster för ANIMARUM-anställda, inklusive: barnomsorg, städtjänster och läxhjälp. Allt för att göra ditt liv lite mindre stressigt.** 









**Att ge tillbaka till samhället** 




**Vi tror på kraften i att göra gott. Därför får våra medarbetare varje år möjlighet att donera ett bestämt belopp till en välgörenhet de själva väljer. Oavsett om det handlar om att stötta utbildning, miljön eller människor i behov, ger vi vårt team möjlighet att bidra till det de brinner för.** 









**Konkurrenskraftiga löner och optionsprogram** 




**Vi vet att vår största tillgång är vårt fantastiska team, och vi tycker att det ska återspeglas i lönekuvertet! Därför erbjuder vi flera flexibla och konkurrenskraftiga lönepaket för att passa alla:** 









**Oavsett vilket paket du väljer är vi engagerade i att säkerställa att du blir rättvist belönad och att du har friheten att forma din egen inkomst.**

title: Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset söker Fullstack-utvecklare till applikationsutvecklingsteamet
description:
Karolinska Universitetssjukhusets IT-avdelning söker dig som har erfarenhet som Fullstack-utvecklare och som vill tänka nytt och skapa digitala lösningar som faktiskt gör skillnad i vårdens vardag.
   

  

 Vår vision är enkel men kraftfull: Vi ska bota och lindra imorgon det ingen kan bota och lindra idag. För att nå dit räcker det inte bara med medicinsk expertis – vi behöver informationsstrukturer i världsklass och digitala verktyg som gör skillnad på riktigt.
   

  

**Du erbjuds**
* en utvecklande roll med tydligt syfte – att utveckla Karolinskas IT-lösningar
* ett nära samarbete med både vårdverksamhet och IT
* kollegor som brinner för sitt uppdrag och en arbetsplats där kunskap och engagemang står i fokus
* ett meningsfullt arbete i en framtidsinriktad organisation
* möjligheten att arbeta på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset – rankat som världens femte bästa sjukhus 2025 och för andra gången Europas bästa, enligt Newsweeks globala lista World's Best Hospitals.


 Självklart får du också ta del av våra generella förmåner som Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset erbjuder dig.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Som Fullstack-utvecklare hos oss blir du en del av ett team som inte nöjer sig med det som redan finns på marknaden. Vi bygger egna, innovativa lösningar som ger läkare och sjuksköterskor bättre beslutsstöd, exakta prognoser och en tryggare arbetsmiljö.
   

  

**Dina Arbetsuppgifter Kommer Bland Annat Att Bestå Av Att**
* Bygga nytt och förbättra: Du utvecklar allt från helt nya applikationer till att rulla ut smarta funktioner i befintliga system.
* Vara nära verkligheten: Du sitter inte bara bakom en skärm. Du jobbar nära vårdpersonalen för att förstå deras vardag och hur din kod bäst kan hjälpa dem.
* Jobba modernt: Vi tillämpar agila metoder och DevOps-principer i en dynamisk miljö där din kreativitet värdesätts högt.
* Möjlighet till ledarskap: Är du en fena på att coacha team? En av oss ska ta rollen som Scrum Master – berätta gärna om det är du!


**Vi söker dig som**
* Har ett stort intresse för applikationsutveckling
* Är noggrann och ansvarstagande
* Trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team
* Gillar problemlösning och är nyfiken på ny teknik


**Kvalifikationer**
**Krav**
* Jobbat fem år eller mer som Fullstack-utvecklare.
* God kunskap om ASP .NET Core C#, TypeScript, SPA, CSS och HTML – och som är noga med att skriva kod av hög kvalitet.
* Har erfarenhet av skriva tester för både frontend och backend.
* Ett öga för design och erfarenhet av att utveckla i nära dialog med de som faktiskt ska använda produkten.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska.


**Meriterande**
* Har arbetat med Docker eller Kubernetes.
* Har erfarenhet från hälso- och sjukvård eller regulatoriska krav (men det är inget krav – vi lär dig gärna!).
* Har ett intresse för – eller erfarenhet av – att använda AI-verktyg för att effektivisera ditt dagliga utvecklingsarbete.


**Om rekryteringsprocessen**
 Vi arbetar så snabbt vi kan för att göra ett rättvist och effektivt urvalsarbete. Ansökningstiden för denna tjänst sträcker sig över semesterperioden. Vi planerar att påbörja urvalet under vecka 31 och kommer att kontakta kandidater så snart vi vet vilka sökande som går vidare till nästa steg i rekryteringsprocessen.
   

  

 För oss är din faktiska problemlösningsförmåga och kodförståelse viktig. Som en del av intervjuprocessen använder vi oss av ett kodtest. Det viktiga för oss är att du till fullo förstår den kod som har tagits fram. Under intervjun vill vi att du kan resonera kring dina tekniska val och svara på frågor kring hur du tänker kring kodstrukturen. Vi är helt enkelt mer intresserade av din arkitektoniska tanke och ditt slutresultat än om du kan syntax utantill.
   

  

 I vår rekryteringsprocess kan vi komma att använda oss av Assessios tester MAP och Matrigma. MAP är ett personlighetstest och Matrigma är ett icke-verbalt begåvningstest och båda bygger på arbetspsykologisk forskning. Testerna används som ett komplement till dina erfarenheter och kompetenser och syftet är att göra vår urvalsprocess kvalitetssäker och transparent.
   

  

 I samband med din ansökan behöver du bifoga CV. Istället för ett personligt brev ber vi dig besvara urvalsfrågor samt kort motivera varför du passar för rollen. Att besvara frågorna är en förutsättning för att din ansökan ska anses komplett.
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan - Tillsammans är vi Karolinska!
   

  

 Inför tillsättning av befattning som innefattar vård av barn och ungdom, kontrolleras den som erbjuds tjänsten mot misstanke- och belastningsregistret. Här kan du läsa mer om rekryteringsprocessen och om vilka kontroller som utförs på Karolinska.
   

  

 Som anställd på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset kan du komma att krigsplaceras. Läs mer om vad det innebär här.
   

  

 Om du är eller tidigare har varit anställd i Region Stockholm kommer vi att ta interna referenser från din nuvarande eller tidigare chef om du blir aktuell för anställning.
   

  

 För tillsvidaretjänster kan provanställning komma att tillämpas.
   

  

**Om Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset**
 Vi på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset är stolta över att vi är ett av världens främsta universitetssjukhus. Förutom vårt särskilda ansvar för den högspecialiserade vården i Stockholmsregionen är huvuduppdraget att tillsammans med Karolinska Institutet utbilda framtidens vårdanställda och bedriva världsledande forskning samtidigt som vi fortsätter vårt arbete med att utveckla vården för patientens bästa. Vi arbetar inom en rad olika områden och professioner.
   

  

 Du kan läsa mer om vårt uppdrag inom vård, forskning och utbildning här.
   

  

 Vår vision - Vi ska bota och lindra imorgon det ingen kan bota och lindra idag.
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om oss på karolinska.se och följ oss på sociala medier!
   

  

**Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm**
 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.
   

  

 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  

 Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.
   

  

 Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.

title: Senior Backend Developer – Omni Core Platform
description:
**Om Omni**
 Omni har funnits på den svenska mediemarknaden sedan november 2013 och är ett självständigt bolag inom Schibsted. Vi är Sveriges femte största nyhetstjänst med runt 800 000 unika läsare och har flera gånger utsetts till Sveriges bästa nyhetstjänst. Vår huvudplattform är mobilen, men vi har också många läsare på desktop och surfplatta.
   

  

 Varje dag använder hundratusentals människor Omni för att förstå vad som händer i världen. Bakom upplevelsen finns en teknisk plattform som måste vara snabb, stabil och skalbar – dygnet runt.
   

  

 Hos oss arbetar Tech, redaktion och produkt nära varandra. AI och agentiska kodverktyg är en naturlig del av hur vi utvecklar, testar och levererar mjukvara. Nu söker vi en senior backendutvecklare som vill vara med och vidareutveckla Omnis kärnplattform.
   

  

**Rollen**
 Du blir en del av vårt ordinarie utvecklingsteam på tio personer och får en central roll i att utveckla systemen bakom en av Sveriges starkaste nyhetstjänster. Du bygger backendtjänster, API:er och integrationer, utvecklar arkitekturen och ser till att våra system fungerar stabilt i produktion.
   

  

 Du har ett arkitektperspektiv, vågar utmana hur vi gör saker idag och är lika hemma i koden som i pipelinen som tar den till produktion. DevOps är inte någon annans problem för dig – det är en naturlig del av hur du bygger.
   

  

*Det här är en projektanställning på 12 månader med goda möjligheter till förlängning.*
**Vad du gör**
* Designar och bygger skalbara backendtjänster, API:er och integrationer som driver en av Sveriges starkaste nyhetsprodukter.
* Sätter teknisk riktning och arkitektur i din domän, och utmanar status quo när det behövs.
* Äger dina tjänster i drift: bygger, deployar och håller dem stabila i produktion.
* Jobbar med vårt event-drivna flöde: ingestion, parsning, köer och pipelines.
* Förbättrar hur vi levererar kod, från CI/CD och containrar till observability.
* Granskar kod, delar kunskap och höjer ribban i teamet.


**Vår stack**
 Du behöver inte ha allt från dag ett, men det här är vad du jobbar med:
   

  

* Backend: Node.js med TypeScript, Hono och Express, tRPC, Zod, Drizzle
* Data: PostgreSQL, Redis
* Event/integration: AWS SQS/SNS, S3
* Infra & drift: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, SQS/SNS), Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, Helm
* Leverans: GitHub Actions, Docker, GitOps, Grafana för observability
* Arbetssätt: pnpm/Turborepo-monorepos, Biome, Vitest, Playwright, MSW


 Frontend i React och Next.js finns nära, och det är ett plus om du kan röra dig dit när det behövs, men tyngdpunkten i rollen är backend och drift.
   

  

 Vi använder agentiska kodverktyg som Claude Code och Codex i det dagliga utvecklingsarbetet. Du behöver inte vara expert från start, men du är nyfiken på hur AI kan göra utveckling snabbare och bättre – och vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med oss.
   

  

**Vi tror att du**
* Har gedigen backenderfarenhet inom arkitektur, API:er och integrationer, och har levererat produktionsdugliga system.
* Är stark på DevOps: CI/CD, containrar, Kubernetes och infrastruktur som kod.
* Har ett arkitektperspektiv och gillar att sätta teknisk riktning och förbättra plattformar över tid.
* Är prestigelös och pragmatisk, bryr dig mer om att lösa problemet än om att få cred.
* Är nyfiken på AI och moderna utvecklingsverktyg.
* Delar gärna med dig och lyfter teamet genom code reviews och kunskapsdelning.
* Kommunicerar tydligt på svenska och engelska.


 Det är ett plus om du också är bekväm i frontend, men det är backend och drift vi söker.
   

  

**Hur vi jobbar**
 Som en del av vårt kompakta och snabbrörliga team får du en miljö där varje röst väger tungt. Vi lever efter en prestigelös och pragmatisk kultur som vilar på genuint samarbete. Genom kontinuerliga code reviews främjar vi både kvalitetssäkring och aktiv kunskapsspridning. Vi prioriterar robusta och okomplicerade lösningar, samtidigt som vi drivs av en passion för att utforska nya tekniker som kan lyfta vår produkt ytterligare.
   

  

 Vi har en hybrid arbetsmiljö med kontor i Stockholm där majoriteten av teamet sitter, och kollegor i Oslo och Gdansk. Vi är flexibla kring distans kontra kontor, och du kan räkna med en sund balans mellan jobb och fritid.

title: Operations Developer
description:
As an Operations Developer within Operations, you will play a key role in strengthening the business at one of the leading installation companies in the Nordics. Our team works on strategic projects across the Group, covering the full range of Commercial and Production excellence.
   

  

 Your new role & team
   

  

 This is the role for someone who wants to make a real difference, working on high impact projects and strategic topics for Bravida Group. The role is tailored for someone with an ability and interest to work across a range of topics or areas, shifting from strategy to implementation, and building strong relationships with the business. Your collaborators and stakeholders will range from Group Management to technicians in our local branches.
   

  

 The team is characterized by strong drive, fast pace, and a culture where we support one another. We have a track record of getting things done and affecting real change in the business. You will be based at the head office in Stockholm, but with a Nordic scope. At times, this will involve traveling to other Nordic countries.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who
   

  

* Is positive, solution-oriented and has strong communication skills
* Is proactive and independent — you take initiative and move projects forward
* Is curious and attentive — you build strong relationships and understand business needs
* Has strong analytical ability and can turn theory into practice
* Can manage both a broad perspective and dive deep into details when needed


 Experience we are looking for
   

  

* A university degree in engineering, business, or equivalent (Master’s or Bachelor’s degree)
* ~2 years of experience in consulting and/or project management within strategy or operations development
* Very strong communication and presentation skills in Swedish and English (other Nordic languages are considered an advantage)
* Experience working with senior decision-makers as well as operational teams


 Please attach your CV, cover letter and grade transcript from University in the application.

title: Var med och bygg framtiden inom finans! Vi söker erfarna utvecklare.
description:
*Garantum grundades 2004 och är en privatägd koncern verksamma inom förmögenhetsförvaltning för privatpersoner, företag och institutioner. Vi erbjuder diskretionär förvaltning, utvalda fonder från marknadens främsta fondbolag, aktiehandel samt strukturerade produkter där vi är Nordens största arrangör. Idag är vi över 190 anställda samt 140 anknutna rådgivare verksamma i 33 städer i Sverige och Norge.*

 Vi är 10 personer och har primärt en Microsoftbaserad miljö (MSDynamics CRM, SQL, C#, SSRS, DevOps, Git) men även viktiga applikationer baserade på JavaScript (VueJS) och MongoDB. . Vi jobbar oftast väldigt brett och många av oss jobbar både i front end och backend.
   

  

 Till webben använder vi Optimizely och egenbyggd plattform baserade på MongoDB och VueJS.
   

  

 Huvudsakliga tekniker vi använder är .Net, c#, MS SQL, MongoDB, SSRS, Rabbit MQ, DevOps, Entity Framework, WCF, REST
   

  

**Lämplig bakgrund**
 Vi vill att du brinner för affärsnytta. IT ska skapa verktyg och möjligheter för affären. Därför är det meriterande om du har erfarenhet av finans eller i alla fall ett finansintresse.
   

  

 Vi söker primärt erfarna utvecklare (+5 år) men om du har kortare erfarenhet och en ingenjörsutbildning i botten är du välkommen att höra av dig ändå.
   

  

* Front End/ Fullstack – Specialistkompetens i Java Script, gärna Vue. Front End-utvecklare hos oss behöver även kunna jobba ganska mycket Backend och vi har en hel del avacerad affärslogik i FrontEnd.


 Meriterande: DevOps, GIT, BankID-tjänster, Köhantering/MQ
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
**Utveckling av affärskritiska funktioner**
 Verksamheten utvecklas i snabb takt vilket ställer nya krav på våra system. Du kommer tillsammans med de övriga i teamet utveckla systemfunktioner för att stödja verksamheten.
   

  

**Integration av system**
 En stor del av vår vardag består i att integrera system vid förändring eller nya funktioner.
   

  

**Kravställning**
 Du kommer tillsammans med verksamheten arbeta fram funktionella krav som efter prioritering kommer att utvecklas.
   

  

**Förvaltning och support**
 Du kommer att tillsammans med teamet ansvara för förvaltning och support av befintliga system och miljöer.
   

  

 För mer information angående den här tjänsten, kontakta Martin Skugge, tel: 070-716 98 24.

title: Mjukvaruutvecklare (försvarsindustrin)
description:
På Capgemini Engineering, världsledande inom ingenjörstjänster, samlar vi ett globalt team av ingenjörer, forskare och arkitekter för att hjälpa världens mest innovativa företag att nå sin fulla potential. Från självkörande bilar till livräddande robotar, våra experter inom digital och mjukvaruteknik tänker utanför boxen när de levererar unika R&D- och engineering-tjänster inom alla branscher. Bli en del av oss för en karriär full av möjligheter. Där du kan göra skillnad och där ingen dag är den andra lik.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Som mjukvaruutvecklare hos Capgemini Engineering kommer du att arbeta med avancerad teknologi med möjlighet till både lokala och globala projekt. Där kommer du få möjlighet att agera både rådgivare, innovatör och utvecklare mot våra slutkunder.
   

  

*I den här rollen kommer du att ha en nyckeroll i:*

title: Principal Software Engineer

title: Automation Specialist
description:
**Please note that due to the summer holiday period, our recruitment process may take a little longer than usual. We look forward to reviewing your application and will provide an update in August.**
 At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.
   

  

 We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for an
 **Automation Specialist** 
 in our
 **Stockholm** 
 office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 As an Automation Specialist, you will have an operative role overseeing all aspects of automation within our finance organisation. By designing, developing, and implementing automated processes, as well as optimizing existing automation solutions, you will help streamline finance operations and drive efficiency.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity for a forward-thinking individual who is passionate about leveraging automation and AI to create real business impact. The role is part of Viaplay Group’s Global Business Services and reports to the Head of IT Finance.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Use AI tools as a natural part of developing automation solutions
* Develop and implement automation solutions to enhance productivity and reduce operational costs
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify automation opportunities and prioritize initiatives based on potential impact
* Design and deploy automation solutions using a range of technologies and tools (e.g. AI, RPA, Power Platform, Python, Azure)
* Monitor and evaluate automation performance, making necessary adjustments to optimize efficiency and reliability
* Stay up to date with emerging automation and AI trends and technologies, incorporating new advancements into the Group’s roadmap
* Establish and maintain best practices, standards, and documentation for automation processes


 What we’re looking for
   

  

 We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (advanced degree preferred)
* 2+ years of hands-on experience working with automation
* Experience with automation tools and technologies such as UiPath, Power Platform, Azure, Python, SQL, and AI tools
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* A proactive mindset and a demonstrated ability to drive change and innovation
* Solid understanding of business processes and operations, with a focus on continuous improvement


 What we offer you
   

  

**We’ve got you covered!** 
 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
   

  

**Your wellbeing matters.** 
 We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
   

  

**A safe space to grow and up-skill.** 
 Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
   

  

**Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do** 
 . So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including series & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.
   

  

 Hit play today
   

  

 If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.
   

  

 Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Customer Engineer, AI Natives, Junior Talent Programme, Nordics
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related STEM discipline (e.g., Computer Engineering, Information Systems), or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience programming or scripting in one or more modern languages (e.g., Python, Go, Java, C++) with experience in fundamental Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA).
* Experience working with databases (SQL or NoSQL), web technologies (APIs, HTTP), or cloud infrastructure through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional experience.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience participating in hackathons, contributing to open-source projects, or building and deploying personal applications/tools.
* Experience working with Large Language Model (LLM) APIs, prompt engineering, vector databases, or building basic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications or simple conversational agents.
* Experience communicating technical concepts clearly to different audiences.
* Experience working in collaborative environments (such as team projects, customer service, or technical residency programs) with an ability to adapt quickly to changing customer needs and new technical domains.
* Strong debugging skills and familiarity with configuring developer environments (e.g., using Docker or basic Linux command line tools).


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 Securing engineering talent in the agentic era requires a highly targeted approach that prioritizes direct capability and technical curiosity.
   

  

 As a Customer Engineer (CE), you will play a pivotal role in supporting the pre-sales lifecycle and technical validation phases. You will act as an early-career builder-CE establishing credibility and excitement by assembling, debugging, and spinning up rapid, real-time prototypes and interactive demos directly for customers.
   

  

 In this role, you will partner closely with senior CEs and Sales teams to understand customer environments, map out their technical needs, and showcase the art of the possible across the full Google Cloud portfolio. As an AI-savvy, professional who is adept at leveraging AI tools, you will address all Platform CE topics across the entire portfolio.Your primary focus is supporting the technical win through customer intimacy, architecture advisory and execution. By maintaining a strong builder mindset, you will write clean demo code, troubleshoot API integrations, and help transition projects to post-sales teams to ensure customer workloads are successfully deployed and adopted.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

 Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
   

  

 Sweden: kr680000 - kr695000 (SEK) + 42.86% bonus target + equity + benefits
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Learn more about benefits at Google .
   

  

* Help build creative solutions to challenging customer needs using Google Cloud. Improve product feature offerings by providing customer feedback to internal cross-functional teams including Product Management and Engineering.
* Collaborate with customers and other Googlers to manage and drive successful adoption of Google Cloud. Help develop recommendations for solution architectures and consulting services.
* Guide customers through the entire innovation lifecycle, building strategic roadmaps and driving achievement of key milestones.
* Solve customers' operational issues through problem solving and technical troubleshooting, while working with internal teams to drive resolution. Help customers get answers to product questions.
* Learn and adopt the latest AI, machine learning, and cloud technologies. Gather feedback from builders and developers in the field and share insights with Google Cloud Product and Engineering teams to help improve our developer tools.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Bannerflow is a fast-growing global SaaS company building a Creative Intelligence Platform that enables enterprise brands to predict, create, and optimize advertising across channels.
   

  

 We’re on a company-wide AI transformation journey, where AI and agentic workflows are becoming a core part of how we build and innovate, with high expectations on adoption across all teams.
   

  

 Our teams are highly autonomous, collaborative, and we are now looking for another passionate engineer to join us!
   

  

**The challenge: Scaling data for the future**
 Our Platform Serves 500+ Million Impressions Daily, With Peaks Over 1 Billion Impressions, And We’re Just Getting Started. We’re Currently Rebuilding Our Entire Data Infrastructure From The Ground Up To Adopt a Data Lakehouse Approach, Enabling
   

  

* Scalability & Flexibility: Handling billions of data points while staying cost-efficient and future-proof.
* Data-Driven Features (AI & ML): Enabling predictive models and automation based on historical data.
* Business Intelligence & Analytics: Delivering insights directly to customers in our platform.


 To make this vision a reality, we’re looking for an experienced Data Platform Engineer to join our Platform team, and take full ownership of designing and building a scalable, high-performance data platform that will power the next generation of our product.
   

  

**Are you + Bannerflow = True? 🦋**
 We believe this is an opportunity for you who want to take the technical lead and define our data platform and best practices. Your work will directly impact or product vision, customers, and drive innovation in Ad Tech as part of an autonomous tech team. You'll tackle cutting-edge challenges in large-scale data processing, ML pipelines, and advanced analytics.
   

  

 At Bannerflow, we live by our values of passion, collaboration, and challenge. You'll be part of a vibrant culture with activities like board game nights, Friday beers, and Level-up Hackathons. We offer a hybrid workplace and a competitive compensation package, including pension according to ITP1, health allowance, parental leave top-up, and health care insurance.
   

  

**Your mission**
* Design and build scalable data pipelines for analytics and AI-driven features.
* Build on our existing lakehouse foundations to shape the architecture's next stage, balancing performance, flexibility, and cost.
* Ensure high data quality and reliability, implementing best practices in data modelling, governance and observability.
* Collaborate closely with our Data Analysts, Chief Architect, Engineers, and Product teams to create data-driven features and insights.
* Evaluate and implement new technologies to ensure a modern, scalable, and future-proof data stack.


**So, what are we looking for?**
* 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer/Data Platform Engineer/Data Lead, working with large-scale data processing.
* Strong knowledge of cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure, or AWS).
* Experience working with data lake and lakehouse technologies (cloud storage solutions, Iceberg tables, Delta Lake, etc.).
* Experience working with workflow orchestration platforms such as Prefect, Dagster, or Airflow, including designing, implementing, and operating data workflows in production environments.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, including data modeling, query optimization, and building reliable data movement patterns between operational and analytical systems.
* Experience with designing scalable architectures and pipelines that support large datasets efficiently.
* Passion for AI/ML-driven data features and enabling advanced analytics.
* Problem-solver mindset, you love optimizing performance and building robust systems.
* Curiosity & ownership – you thrive in an environment where you can experiment and improve.


**Not sure if you check all the boxes? Apply anyway!**
 We believe that mindset and passion are just as important as technical skills. If you have a software engineering background, love solving complex problems, and are a data nerd at heart, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t meet every requirement. We’re looking for the right person, not just the perfect resume. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.
   

  

 Join us at Bannerflow and help us build a world-class data platform that powers the future of Ad Tech!
   

  

**A quick summer note** 
 🌞 Please apply as usual, we'd still love to hear from you! Many of us are taking time off right now, so applications will only be reviewed sporadically until we're back to our usual pace in August. Thanks for your patience.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Europe's public institutions serve hundreds of millions of people, and most lack the AI infrastructure to do it well. Intric is changing that. Our sovereign AI platform is already used by 70+ municipalities, governments, and institutions. We've built a leading position in Sweden and are expanding across Europe.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Be the technical owner within customer engagements, working alongside sales and customer success from pre-sales through go-live
* Build integrations across APIs, authentication systems, data pipelines, and document platforms
* Deploy Intric in on-prem and private cloud environments with strict security requirements
* Debug what no one else can figure out, in environments with limited tooling and high constraints
* Turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions customers rely on daily
* Prioritize ruthlessly across competing demands, from a position of knowledge rather than whoever is loudest
* Feed real-world deployment insights back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap


**Who you are**
 You've shipped things that other people depend on. You've been on-call when they broke. You've dealt with real production risk, real failure, and end-to-end ownership without a safety net. That background is what makes the rest of this possible.
   

  

* You work across the full stack without needing to hand off: frontend, backend, infrastructure, AI layer, GitOps, networking, protocols, raw API work
* You take ownership of customer outcomes, not individual tasks. If the customer isn't reaching their goal, that's your problem to solve.
* You can say no to the wrong thing and yes to the right one, even under pressure from the customer.
* You can explain a technical decision to a non-technical department manager and defend it to their engineers, often in the same meeting
* You're effective in ambiguous, under-documented, high-constraint environments


**Fluent** 
**Swedish and English are both required for this role.**
 Your title might have been Implementation Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or something else entirely. What matters is what you actually did: owning delivery in customer environments, end to end, with real stakes attached.
   

  

**What You'll Gain**
 You'll build a combination that's hard to find elsewhere: production-level AI deployment experience in high-security environments, across multiple industries, with direct ownership of customer outcomes from start to finish.
   

  

* Hands-on experience deploying AI in production-critical, high-security environments
* Exposure to complex enterprise architectures across sectors and countries
* Direct influence on product direction through real deployment feedback


**What this job actually looks like**
**Up to 80% of your work happens in customer environments, alongside their technical teams primarly across Sweden with some cross-Nordics travel as projects require** 
 . You learn their systems, integrate the platform, and own the outcome from the first sales conversation through go-live and beyond.
   

  

 The environment spans Python, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, self-hosted LLMs, and Svelte. You won't use all of it on every project, but you need to move across the stack as the situation demands. You use AI tools well and quickly, but your value is the judgment behind them: knowing what to build, how to prioritize, and when to push back.
   

  

 Your default is finding the path, not describing the obstacle. Sometimes that means telling a customer that what they're asking for is the wrong thing to build. Both are part of the job.
   

  

**Why Intric**
* One of Europe's most trusted AI platforms for regulated organizations
* Funded and growing: you're joining before the scale curve, not after
* High ownership and decision-making authority from day one
* A team that takes quality, security, and long-term trust seriously


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and equity
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension) with fund choice and advisory meetings, plus sjukförsäkring, premiebefrielse, TFA, and TGL
* 25 days paid vacation
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)

title: H&M Kids Fashion Designer - Girls Woven

**For more information and a chance to be considered for current and future opportunities please apply with your latest CV and Portfolio (in English). A member of our Recruitment team will be in touch if we feel you are a great match.**

title: Site Reliability & DevOps Engineer
description:
Our games run on infrastructure that has to work - at scale, under pressure, with real players on the other end. If you're the kind of engineer who gets quietly annoyed when something could be more reliable, more automated, or more elegant, and then actually goes and fixes it, this might be the right role for you.
 



  





 About the role
 



 You'll be a key part of building and maintaining the cloud infrastructure that powers our games. Working closely with our client and backend developers, you'll make sure our services are scalable, secure, and running smoothly - so our game teams can focus on making great games rather than fighting fires.
 



 This is a hands-on role. You'll design and own infrastructure, build CI/CD pipelines, develop microservices, and drive automation across the stack. You'll also work directly with game teams to support releases and live operations - which means you'll need to be comfortable operating across disciplines, not just inside a silo.
 



  





 What you'll be doing
 



 • Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure for our backend services and tools
 



 • Deploy and monitor backend services, managing performance and minimising downtime
 



 • Develop and maintain scalable microservices to support game functionality and growth
 



 • Build, implement, and optimise CI/CD pipelines for reliable software delivery
 



 • Drive automation across infrastructure to increase speed and reduce manual work
 



 • Support game teams with tooling and documentation for releases and live operations
 



  





 What we need from you
 



 • Proven hands-on professional experience as an SRE or DevOps engineer – you will be taking over from our sole responsible and leading the space in the studio.
 



 • Strong infrastructure and networking knowledge: DNS, VPCs, firewalls, VPNs, load balancers, certificate management, and Kubernetes ingress
 



 • IAM and security experience: OAUTH, SAML, and federated identity management in GCP and AWS
 



 • Hands-on experience with: Terraform, GKE/EKS, Packer, Git, ArgoCD, Grafana, GCP Monitoring, BigQuery
 



 • Experience with CI/CD and development tools: GitHub Actions, Slack, Unity SCM or similar
 



  





 Useful but not required
 



 • Strong scripting or programming background - C#, Rust, Python or similar
 



 • Experience in game development or the games industry
 



 • Familiarity with the specific requirements of AR and VR games
 



 • Experience driving security initiatives
 



 • Willingness to pick up new tools: Rust, PowerShell, Agones/Open-Match
 



  





 Who you are
 



 You are proactive and collaborative - you spot problems before they become incidents and you build solutions that others can use, not just workarounds that only make sense to you. You work well with cross-functional teams and you are comfortable explaining technical decisions to people who are not engineers. You care about doing things properly but you also know when good enough is the right answer.
 



  





 Who we are
 



 Resolution Games is a Stockholm-based games studio with a proven track record creating immersive gaming experiences. We got our start in VR and AR and still believe spatial gaming is where the most interesting things are happening - but our work now spans PC, console, and beyond. As players and developers, we have spent years putting our energy into making the most of new platforms: creating positive first experiences for someone stepping into XR for the first time, and building deep, replayable games that keep enthusiasts coming back for more.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who wants a unique opportunity and enjoys collaborating. Someone who wants to be part of a team raising the bar and creating a new set of standards. Our colleagues have can-do attitudes and appreciate a small studio culture. Even though we have grown, we continue to work in small teams, experiment, and tackle complex challenges. We value having every voice heard and seek out diversity, equity, and inclusion in everything we do. We believe in team over the individual, a great mix of freedom with responsibility, and that people should always come before the process. P.S. Employee stock options are available.
 



  





 How we work
 



 We are an office-first studio. We think being in the same room makes the work better and the team stronger - and honestly, it shows in what we build. We are flexible on start and finish times, and the occasional work-from-home day is part of life.
 



  





 Sound like you?
 



 We will start looking at applicants on a rolling basis from early August, so if you are interested, apply now and we will be in touch then.

title: Technical Product Owner - Core Services
description:
**Location**  

Our Technical Product Owner - DoiT Cloud Intelligence - Core Services will be an integral part of our global Product team. This role is based remotely in the East Coast US, the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel.


**Who We Are**  

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multi-cloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.


**The Opportunity**  

We're hiring a Technical Product Owner to drive rapid delivery and iteration for the Core Services team of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, our platform that helps DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, and FinOps teams manage public cloud environments effectively and efficiently. Core Services builds and operates foundational platform capabilities used across DoiT's products and engineering teams. Its responsibilities include identity and access management, authentication and authorization, customer and tenant services, shared APIs, platform integrations, and other cross-cutting capabilities. This role is designed for someone with a technical product mindset who is comfortable working deep within platform architecture, distributed systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and internal engineering workflows. You will help turn broad platform needs into clear technical product direction, sequenced investments, and reliably delivered capabilities. You will report to a VP of Product and work as an embedded member of the Core Services Engineering team. You will collaborate closely with engineering leadership, architects, security, product teams, and internal platform consumers to determine what the team should build next and why.


**Role clarity: VP of Product vs. Technical Product Owner**


**VP of Product (what they own)**


* Sets the overall vision, strategy, positioning, and long-range roadmap for the platform area.
* Makes the highest-level prioritization calls across multiple components and investment themes.
* Aligns stakeholders across the company (executive leadership, GTM, partners) on direction and tradeoffs.
* Defines success at the portfolio/area level and ensures the area's outcomes ladder up to company goals.


**Technical Product Owner (what you own)**


* Owns delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for the Core Services.
* Turns VP-level direction into clear problems to solve, a prioritized backlog, and incrementally shippable scope.
* Runs the feedback loop: discover define build release measure iterate, repeatedly.
* Works within the Engineering teams to ensure they are always building the highest-value next increment with clarity, quality
* Review technical designs, reason about tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer
* Leverages deep, hands-on DevOps experience and public cloud understanding to ensure that solution implementations are done correctly


This distinction matters: the VP creates the "why" and "where"; the Product Owner ensures the "what next" is always sharp, validated, and shipping.


**Responsibilities**


**Fast iteration and backlog leadership**


* Translate the VP's strategy into a sequenced backlog of problems, user stories, and acceptance criteria that the Engineering team can deliver continuously.
* Keep work "thin-sliced" so the team can ship frequently, learn quickly, and reduce risk through iteration.
* Maintain a disciplined cadence of backlog refinement, sprint readiness, and scope negotiation to keep delivery predictable without slowing innovation.


**Deep user and workflow understanding**


* Leverage your hands-on DevOps experience and expertise in the real-world workflows of the professionals you're building for - especially cloud operators and practitioners.
* Use firsthand domain knowledge and ongoing customer conversations to identify friction, gaps, and opportunities for differentiation.
* Prioritize enhancements that materially improve outcomes: speed, reliability, clarity, safety, governance, cost impact, or operational simplicity.


**Customer validation and external communication**


* Often speak with customers (aiming for 3-5 calls a week) and cross-functional DoiT stakeholders regularly to test ideas, validate assumptions, and pressure-test tradeoffs.
* Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into decisions, and explain "why" in a way that builds trust.
* Rely on your hands-on, DevOps experience to go deep with stakeholders (internal/external) into the technical details of the problem, our solution, and the contexts and environments in which both of these exist.
* Support beta/design-partner motions where appropriate by shaping hypotheses, success criteria, and rollout plans.


**Engineering-embedded technical product ownership**


* Operate as a core member of the Core Services' Engineering team - present in daily collaboration, crisp in decision-making, and pragmatic about constraints.
* Partner with Engineering leads on sequencing, technical tradeoffs, and delivery planning - ensuring product intent survives implementation realities.
* Ensure Core Services are cohesive across UX, APIs, data, and operational behavior - and that it meets a high bar for reliability and customer trust.


**Quality, outcomes, and measurement**


* Define what "success" means for Core Services with clear metrics (adoption, activation, workflow completion, time-to-value, retention, reliability signals, customer-reported impact).
* Instrument learning: make sure releases are measurable and that insights reliably flow back into prioritization.
* Own release readiness for Core Services: documentation, enablement inputs, and clear communication of what's new and why it matters.


**Safety, governance, and trust by design**


* Ensure product requirements account for real-world cloud environments: IAM boundaries, auditability, guardrails, and safe defaults.
* Partner with security, support, and customer teams to anticipate edge cases and ensure Core Services earns trust over time.


**Qualifications**


* 7–10 years of hands-on experience as a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, SRE, Cloud Engineer, Solutions Architect, or a similar roles working with or building products for public cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure).
* A strong product sense for turning messy problems into clear scope and shipped value - without waiting for perfect information.
* Systems thinking: Ability to reason about complex distributed systems, architectural tradeoffs, and long-term platform evolution.
* Prioritization: Demonstrated ability to balance customer needs, engineering constraints, and platform investments when making prioritization decisions.
* Deep curiosity and technical fluency in cloud fundamentals (cost/billing concepts, identity/IAM, networking, compute, Kubernetes, observability, automation), and experience building solutions that leverage or focus on these technologies
* Coding experience is a plus - enough to collaborate effectively with engineers, reason about feasibility, and understand system behaviors.
* Excellent communication skills: you can explain complex ideas simply, facilitate alignment, and confidently engage with customers and experts.
* A bias for action and continuous improvement: you ship, measure, learn, and iterate - building capabilities that become a meaningful competitive differentiator.


**How success will be measured**


* The Core Services' roadmap advances through frequent, high-quality releases with clear customer value.
* Customer feedback loops are strong: you can show how insights translated into shipped improvements.
* Adoption and outcomes improve measurably (usage, engagement, workflow completion, reliability, and customer impact).
* The Engineering team consistently has clarity on the next most valuable increment to build - and why.


**Are you a Do'er?**  

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.



We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.


What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.



Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.



We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.



Full-time employee benefits include:


* Unlimited Vacation
* Flexible Working Options
* Health Insurance
* Parental Leave
* Employee Stock Option Plan
* Home Office Allowance
* Professional Development Stipend
* Peer Recognition Program


**Many Do'ers, One Team**  

DoiT unites as *Many Do'ers, One Team*, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
**This is Worldline** 




 Help shape the future of how the world pays and gets paid. At Worldline, we enable businesses of all sizes to grow quickly, simply, and securely. As a leader in the payments industry, we power millions of companies across five continents. Just as we drive our customers' growth, we support our people in building their careers. Together, we shape the evolution of payments.
 



  





 If you're passionate about designing intuitive, beautifully crafted solutions and eager to grow alongside a talented team, this is your chance. Join us and help redefine how the world pays.
 



  





**The opportunity** 




 Design at Worldline is going through an exciting transformation. We're raising the bar — fast. We're building a world-class design system, embedding user-centered thinking deeper into how products are shaped, and growing a diverse, talented team that is genuinely changing how the organisation approaches design. The momentum is real, the ambition is high, and the impact is visible.
 



  





 As a Product Designer in the Worldline Design team, you will play a crucial role in shaping our product portfolio — from the visual identity of our interfaces to the end-to-end experience our customers have with our solutions. Your mission is to advocate for the user's needs while elevating the visual quality and coherence of our products, defining and implementing intuitive solutions for the product direction, visual design, and interaction to enhance the overall user journey. You will bring a keen eye for aesthetics and a strong understanding of user-centered design, combining visual craft with thoughtful interaction design to create experiences that are both beautiful and functional.
 



  





 This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
 



  





**Day-to-day responsibilities** 



* Design visually polished, intuitive interfaces for complex payment solutions — bringing both aesthetic quality and usability together.
* Shape the visual language of our products — contributing to and evolving typography, colour, spacing, iconography, and layout across our portfolio.
* Collaborate with our Design System experts to grow and improve our world-class Design System, ensuring visual consistency and component quality.
* Transform business needs into clear, compelling designs and interactions with attention to visual detail and craft.
* Create high-fidelity UI designs and interactive prototypes that communicate design intent clearly to developers and stakeholders.
* Participate in design workshops and user testing to validate and refine your work together with colleagues.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including product managers, developers, and researchers — to deliver a polished, cohesive user experience.
* Stay ahead of visual design and industry trends, bringing fresh ideas and inspiration that elevate our standards.
* Actively explore opportunities for our business and the field of UX with generative and Agentic AI.
* Validate your designs with real users to measure impact and continuously seek opportunities to optimise and improve their experience.
* Become an active member of the Worldline Design team, contributing to our supportive design culture, critique practices, and shared knowledge.



  





**Who are we looking for** 




 We look for talented, thoughtful designers who care about their craft. People who bring fresh perspectives, step up and show what's next — optimistic, upbeat people with a can-do attitude, a hunger to learn and grow, and a genuine love for collaboration. In practice this means:
 


* 3+ years of experience in product design, with strong skills in both visual/UI design and interaction design.
* A keen eye for visual detail — you care about typography, colour, spacing, hierarchy, and the nuances that elevate an interface from functional to delightful.
* Experience working with and contributing to design systems, with an understanding of how visual consistency scales across products.
* Experience working with scrum teams and excellent skills in Figma and other design tools, including high-fidelity UI design and prototyping.
* Strong analytical skills — you get to the bottom of things to understand core problems, not just the surface level.
* Knowledge of user research practices and experience using usability testing platforms.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to present your design thinking clearly to audiences with varying levels of design understanding.
* Deep empathy for users and a passion for representing their needs and motivations to diverse stakeholder groups.
* Creative problem-solving skills and a thoughtful, proactive mindset in identifying opportunities for improving the user experience.
* An optimistic, collaborative personality — you bring warmth and energy to the team, value diverse perspectives, and believe the best work happens when people support each other.
* Experience in B2B SaaS and/or the Payments sector is a nice-to-have — strong design skills are what matter most, and industry knowledge you'll pick up on the job.
* You have an online portfolio showcasing your visual and product design work, which you can share upon application.
* You are available to work full time.



  





**Perks & Benefits** 




 At Worldline you'll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:
 


* Work with inspiring colleagues in a supportive, inclusive environment and be empowered to learn, grow and accelerate your career.
* At Worldline our top priority is to engage, encourage and develop you to help you improve your potential. We have comprehensive training and development programs in place demonstrating our dedication to developing your career.
* Health contribution
* Health check – Every 2:nd year
* Private Health Care Insurance (EuroAccident)
* Parental pay and 12 months pension during parental leave
* Opportunity to hybrid working according to company standard
* Benefit portal with many great offers, plus more.



  





**Shape the evolution.** 




 We are pushing towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for talented people to join our journey. People with passion, a can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on society. And with our empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career. Wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of over 18,000 innovators across 40+ countries, and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
 



  





 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
 



  





 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, colour, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Technical UI Designer
description:
**Description & Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 Battlefield is a storied franchise renowned for uncompromising combat gameplay and all-out warfare, for over two decades. 100 million players and 5 billion hours played later, Battlefield Studios is defining the future of the first-person shooter with the biggest launch in franchise history with Battlefield 6, and a new era beginning with Battlefield REDSEC.
   

  

 United under the banner of Battlefield Studios, 4 world-class teams across Criterion, DICE, Motive, and Ripple Effect have come together to focus on the future of the franchise, a connected Battlefield universe filled with immersive experiences built on our unique DNA.
   

  

 LET’S PUSH THINGS FORWARD
   

  

 DICE is a creative studio with offices in Stockholm and Gothenburg. We believe in the power of inclusion and welcome game creators from all backgrounds to collaborate with us as we unlock the potential for the future of Battlefield!
   

  

 We’re always pushing to be at the forefront of creative entertainment - blending digital art, design, and technology to push boundaries. Our collaborative culture is fueled by passion, driving innovation and making a positive difference for our players and community.
   

  

 At DICE, your ideas matter. We offer an inclusive space where you can thrive, be yourself, and grow alongside a team dedicated to making a meaningful impact to the world of gaming.
   

  

 We’re all-in on the future and our most ambitious Battlefield yet. Want to be part of something special? Read on.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The ideal candidate for the Technical UI Designer position at Electronic Arts is a collaborative, detail-oriented professional with a passion for creating high-quality, accessible user interfaces in games. You thrive in multidisciplinary teams, excel at bridging creative vision with technical execution, and are motivated by the opportunity to impact millions of players worldwide. You are comfortable taking ownership of features from concept to ship, iterating based on feedback, and championing best practices throughout the production cycle.
   

  

**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* Demonstrated experience implementing in-game UI features, including screens, widgets, logic, and data flows, in a professional game development environment
* Strong technical and logical problem-solving abilities, with a track record of delivering polished, AAA-quality UI features on time
* Proficiency in rapid prototyping to test and iterate on UI concepts independently, from ideation through implementation
* Deep understanding of UI/UX design principles, including typography, layout, motion, and visual fidelity
* Commitment to accessibility and inclusive design, with a passion for creating player experiences that are usable by all
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain and refine features throughout the production cycle
* Collaborative mindset with proven ability to work effectively with engineers, scripters, UX designers, UI artists, producers, and directors
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to document features, participate in design and code reviews, and advocate for best practices
* Adaptable and open to feedback, with a willingness to learn and grow within a highly experienced team


**Experience**
* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in game development, working within game engines on AA or AAA titles
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one feature or UI component in a released game, with ownership from implementation to delivery
* Experience collaborating across disciplines (gameplay, engineering, design, art) to deliver high-quality UI features


**Education**
* No specific degree or certification required; candidates from diverse educational backgrounds are encouraged to apply


**Preferred/Bonus Skills**
* Familiarity with additional UI systems such as UMG, Unity UI, Flash, ImGui, WPF, or Qt
* Experience working with proprietary tech stacks or influencing UI frameworks within a large-scale project


**Soft Skills**
* Highly collaborative and inclusive attitude, with the ability to listen, learn, and adapt in a fast-paced, creative environment
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with experience estimating and managing work in partnership with producers and directors
* Passion for games and a desire to contribute to the long-term success of the Battlefield universe


 Join us to help shape the future of UI in one of the industry’s most ambitious projects, working alongside a passionate and experienced team with diverse career growth opportunities.
   

  

**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Lead Product Designer - AI Experiences
description:
**About Us**
 Netigate is a leading European Experience Management (XM) company, helping organizations turn insights into growth by understanding and acting on the experiences of their customers and employees.
   

  

 Headquartered in Stockholm with offices across Europe in Helsinki, Frankfurt and Rotterdam, Netigate serves more than 1,500 clients globally, including Erste Group, KLM/Air France and Apoteket. We are ~130 employees across the Nordic countries in Helsinki, Oslo and Stockholm and in the rest of Europe in Frankfurt, Berlin, Rotterdam, London and Paris.
   

  

 Following the recent merger with the Dutch digital experience platform Mopinion, Netigate now delivers a unique end-to-end platform for experience management - covering every touchpoint across web, mobile, and employee journeys.
   

  

****Your Role at a Glance****
 As Lead Product Designer, AI Experiences, you will shape how customers engage with our platform across the full product journey - from onboarding and core workflows to AI-powered guidance and decision-making. This role goes beyond interface design. You will help define how AI, automation, and connected product experiences can transform the way enterprise customers work with feedback and insights. Working at the intersection of product strategy, user behavior, systems thinking, and AI-native design, you will turn complex workflows into intuitive, high-impact experiences that build trust, drive adoption, and support long-term customer value. You will collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer-facing teams to explore, prototype, validate, and continuously improve experiences across the platform. We are looking for a designer who thinks in systems, workflows, and customer outcomes - not just screens and interfaces.
   

  

 This hybrid role can be based in Helsinki, Stockholm, or Rotterdam, with 2–3 days of office presence per week.
   

  

****Your Key Responsibilities****
* Own and evolve the end-to-end product experience across discovery, onboarding, workflows, AI-assisted interactions, and core platform journeys.
* Define how AI and agentic experiences should behave within enterprise SaaS workflows, balancing usability, transparency, trust, and efficiency.
* Translate customer problems, behavioral insights, and business priorities into intuitive product experiences and validated design hypotheses.
* Drive product discovery together with Product Managers and Engineers through rapid prototyping, experimentation, and customer validation.
* Design and prototype experiences using AI-native tooling (claude, lovable, replit, figma AI, etc) to accelerate iteration and decision-making.
* Contribute to product strategy by identifying workflow friction, opportunity areas, and experience improvements that drive measurable business outcomes.
* Run user research, customer interviews, usability testing, and behavioral analysis to uncover customer needs and validate solutions.
* Use product analytics and experimentation frameworks to continuously improve adoption, engagement, retention, and customer satisfaction.
* Help unify multiple SaaS products into one coherent platform experience, including navigation patterns, interaction models, terminology, and design systems.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering teams to ensure experiences are technically feasible, scalable, and implemented with high quality.
* Champion a modern, AI-native design culture focused on simplicity, experimentation, speed, and measurable customer value.


****Your Profile****
* Several years of experience in Product Design, UX, Product Experience, or related roles within SaaS or digital product companies.
* Strong product thinking and ability to simplify complex workflows into intuitive customer experiences.
* Experience working closely with Product Managers and Engineers in fast-moving, cross-functional environments.
* Strong skills in product discovery, user research, behavioral analysis, and translating customer insights into validated product decisions.
* Fluency with AI-enhanced design and prototyping workflows and Figma.
* Experience using analytics and experimentation tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, Optimizely, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of AI-native interaction patterns, conversational interfaces, copilots, or workflow automation is a strong plus.
* Ability to balance customer needs, technical constraints, and business priorities pragmatically.
* Strong systems thinking and experience contributing to scalable UX patterns or design systems.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS, retail, banking, customer experience, or data-heavy products is highly valued.


****What you can expect****
* The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping shape seamless customer experiences in an AI-driven SaaS platform, while working closely with ambitious Product, Engineering, and Customer teams.
* An inclusive and supportive work environment where diversity and creativity are celebrated.
* An environment where your ideas are valued, and you have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution from the start.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement within an international growing company.
* No matter your role, whether you're just starting out or in a leadership position, we focus on the value you bring to the table. Creativity and impact are what matter most.
* We believe in celebrating our achievements. Wether it's a summer festival or New Year's party: we make sure to enjoy our successes and build strong team connections.


**Our Culture**
 At the heart of Netigate lies the
 **NetiMaker mindset** 
 - our foundation for how we work and grow together. Being a NetiMaker means taking ownership, staying curious, holding ourselves accountable, and driving progress with purpose.
   

  

 We believe that a great employee experience is the foundation of a great customer experience - and this belief shapes everything we do.
   

  

 At Netigate, we pride ourselves on our collaborative, imaginative, and learning-focused culture. We believe in the collective strength of diverse perspectives - the
 *power of WE* 
 . Together, we create an atmosphere where fresh ideas are shared, challenges are embraced, and individual growth is encouraged.
