title: Teamcenter Configuration Specialist
description:
*Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar.*
**Your Role**
 We are part of a large-scale digital transformation programme aimed at digitalising and streamlining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) across our engineering and manufacturing organisation. The programme spans multiple business units and involves deep integration between PLM and ERP systems.
   

  

 We are looking for a Teamcenter (TC) Configuration Specialist to join our project team. Whether you come with a few years of solid hands-on experience or a longer track record, if you know Teamcenter configuration inside out, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 Beyond the project, you will play an important role in the continued development and application management of our Teamcenter platform, helping ensure a stable, scalable and sustainable PLM environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Configure and maintain Siemens Teamcenter environments (structure, workflows, access control, etc.).
* Support and develop variant configuration and product structure management (DBOM/EBOM/MBOM).
* Collaborate with engineering and IT stakeholders to translate business requirements into Teamcenter configurations.
* Troubleshoot configuration issues and act as a subject matter expert during rollout and go-live phases.
* Contribute to documentation, training and best-practice development.
* Contribute to the ongoing development and application management of the Teamcenter platform.
* Support releases, deployments, platform improvements and technical troubleshooting in collaboration with the wider IT organization.


**Your Profile**
 Required Skills & Experience:
   

  

* Hands-on experience configuring Siemens Teamcenter (TC12+ or later preferred).
* Solid understanding of PLM data models, revision rules and configuration contexts.
* Experience with variant management and/or Product Configurator in a Teamcenter environment is a strong advantage.
* Ability to work in cross-functional teams with both IT and engineering colleagues.
* Structured and analytical approach to problem-solving.
* Fluent in English; Swedish is an advantage.


 It is an advantage if you have:
   

  

* Experience with ERP integrations (e.g. IFS or SAP) via middleware solutions.
* Knowledge of SQL and database concepts.
* Experience with system administration, deployments, version management or DevOps practices.
* Familiarity with NovaCura or similar integration frameworks.
* Background in aerospace, defence or other complex manufacturing environments.


 This role offers the opportunity to influence both the implementation of new capabilities and the long-term evolution of a business-critical Teamcenter environment.
   

  

 This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.
   

  

**What You Will Be a Part Of**
 Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
   

  

 Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring mission, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 26,100 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
   

  

 Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations. Read more about us here.

title: Technical Specialist – Service Operations
description:
We are looking for a Technical Specialist to join our team as we continue to grow and strengthen our delivery and operations capabilities to support increasing customer needs.
 



 You will become part of an international team currently consisting of 31 colleagues across Sweden, Finland, and Norway. We are now expanding further and are looking for three new team members to strengthen our Nordic Service Operations team.
 **These positions can be based in Norway, Sweden, or Finland, depending on the successful candidate's location.** 




 Beyond strong technical interest, we are looking for someone who wants to be actively involved in shaping how we work. You stay up to date with industry trends, bring ideas, and take initiative -someone who sees the bigger picture and wants to contribute to both the team and the overall strategy.
 



 As a Technical Specialist at Telenor, you will work hands-on with service operations, solving real customer challenges while continuously learning and developing. You will play a key role in maintaining and improving reliable network infrastructure that customers depend on every day.
 



 In this role, you will work closely with delivery and operations of network services for business customers. Your day-to-day tasks will include planning, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. You will help ensure stable and secure solutions, directly impacting service quality, security, and reliability. From following up on incidents to proactively identifying risks, you will contribute to keeping networks running smoothly.
 



  





**How We Work** 




 You will join a collaborative and supportive team where knowledge sharing is a natural part of how we work and grow together. We collaborate closely with colleagues across sales, product management, and technical environments, combining perspectives to deliver the best possible solutions. You will be trusted with responsibility in your role, while always having support when needed.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Experience or interest in network troubleshooting, security, maintenance, and service operations
* Certification in HPE Aruba, Fortinet and/or Cisco is preferred
* Understanding of customer environments and service processes
* Familiarity with ITSM tools and basic ITIL principles
* Ability to solve problems and make decisions in customer-facing situations
* Basic scripting skills (for example Python or Ansible)



 You do not need to tick every box - what matters most is your motivation, curiosity, and willingness to learn.
 



  





**What You Get With Us** 




 With us, you will have the opportunity to work in a role where your contribution makes a real difference for customers and society. You will continuously build your competence through hands-on experience, collaboration with colleagues, and development of both your technical and professional skills.
 



 We offer flexibility in your workday, including the possibility to work partly from home, and you will be part of a team that values trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
 



 You will work from one of our Telenor offices in Norway, Sweden, or Finland, depending on your location. Across our Nordic offices, we offer modern facilities and collaborative work environments designed to support both professional growth and wellbeing.
 



 We also provide a competitive benefits package including share programmes, pension, and insurance.
 



  





**The practicalities** 




**Application deadline:** 
 09.08.2026
 



**Place of work:** 
 Norway, Sweden or Finland
 



**Contact person:** 
 Joakim Almløf – joakim.almlof@telenor.no
 



**Additional requirements:** 




 . Successful completion of a security check may be required.
 



 . We conduct background checks on relevant candidates through Semac AS.
 



 . Readiness for a 24/7 on-call rotation may be required.
 



 . English is required, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Norwegian, Swedish, or Finnish is an advantage.
 



  





***Ready to make a real difference? Apply now and join us!***




*Telenor Nordics, a business area within the Telenor Group, connects more than 12 million customers across Denmark, Sweden, Finland, and Norway. Our 7,000 Nordic employees are dedicated to building and securing some of the world’s most advanced mobile networks, delivering reliable connectivity, relevant services, and customer excellence. We are committed to being the place where talent thrive and grow as part of a future-ready and empowered workforce, collaborating across the Nordics to create value.*

title: IT Service Manager
description:
Description
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced IT Business Partner – Digital Workplace to join the Transformation Office. The role serves as the strategic link between business stakeholders and IT, ensuring alignment, transparency, and trust across the end-to-end stakeholder experience.
   

  

 ﻿
   

  

 The IT Business Partner (ITBP) is responsible for managing stakeholder relationships and representing Digital Workplace as a coherent service organization rather than a collection of individual products. The role focuses on governance, service management, stakeholder engagement, escalation ownership, and ensuring business needs are translated into actionable demand within a product-based delivery model.
   

  

 ﻿
   

  

 The position requires a strong understanding of IT services, service governance, SLAs, stakeholder management, and financial transparency, while operating without direct ownership of delivery execution or product backlogs.
   

  

 ﻿
   

  

  

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Act as the primary and trusted relationship owner for assigned business stakeholders.
   

  

 Build long-term partnerships between business and IT, ensuring clarity, trust, and alignment.
   

  

 Support stakeholders in articulating business needs, priorities, and constraints.
   

  

 Frame and align business demand with the Digital Workplace product intake and portfolio processes.
   

  

 Manage stakeholder expectations by communicating what is feasible, when it can be delivered, and the associated trade-offs.
   

  

 Maintain a holistic view of the stakeholder experience across products and services, identifying recurring themes and systemic pain points.
   

  

 Collaborate with Product Managers and Product Owners to address cross-product and cross-portfolio challenges.
   

  

 Support initiative owners during major organizational changes, transitions, and transformation activities.
   

  

 Own stakeholder-facing escalations and ensure issues are routed to the appropriate product or portfolio teams.
   

  

 Maintain accountability for escalations until resolution while remaining independent from delivery execution.
   

  

 Ensure visibility, understanding, and communication of agreements between IT and business stakeholders, including service agreements and governance structures.
   

  

 Support the definition, consolidation, communication, and continuous improvement of Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
   

  

 Identify SLA gaps, inconsistencies, and outdated definitions, driving necessary updates and improvements.
   

  

 Provide transparency regarding IT service costs, consumption, invoicing, and financial alignment with business budgets.
   

  

 Support clear and reliable communication between IT and business regarding financial and service governance matters.
   

  

  

  

 Education & Qualifications
   

  

 Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent Level 6 qualification, or equivalent relevant experience.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience.
   

  

 Strong understanding of IT service management and business relationship management.
   

  

 Experience working within product-based delivery organizations is highly desirable.
   

  

  

  

 Experience & Skills
   

  

 Proven experience managing relationships with senior business stakeholders.
   

  

 Strong ability to build trust and influence across business and technology organizations.
   

  

 Experience working with demand management, stakeholder expectation management, and prioritization discussions.
   

  

 Solid understanding of product and service landscapes, including how products, portfolios, and initiatives interact.
   

  

 Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business narratives.
   

  

 Ability to manage difficult conversations, negotiate trade-offs, and maintain transparency in challenging situations.
   

  

 Experience working with service governance frameworks, service agreements, and SLA management.
   

  

 Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify patterns and systemic issues across services.
   

  

 Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and exercise sound professional judgment.
   

  

 Experience handling stakeholder escalations and driving issues toward resolution.
   

  

 Understanding of IT cost structures, consumption models, invoicing processes, and financial governance.
   

  

  

  

 Meritorious Qualifications
   

  

 Experience within large enterprise or global IT environments.
   

  

 Experience supporting digital workplace or end-user technology services.
   

  

 Knowledge of IT governance models and portfolio management practices.
   

  

 Experience working in multinational organizations with multiple legal entities and service structures.
   

  

 Familiarity with service agreement frameworks, including Master Agreements, DORAs, and operational service contracts.
   

  

 Experience working across business transformation or organizational change initiatives.
   

  

  

  

 Who You Are
   

  

 You are a relationship-oriented professional with excellent stakeholder management capabilities and a strong service mindset. You are comfortable operating in complex organizations, balancing business needs with IT realities, and communicating transparently even in challenging situations.
   

  

 ﻿
   

  

 You have a strategic perspective, enjoy connecting people and services, and can see the bigger picture beyond individual products or teams. You are confident engaging with senior stakeholders, facilitating discussions, managing expectations, and ensuring alignment across multiple business and IT functions.
   

  

 Your ability to combine governance, communication, and business understanding makes you a trusted partner who helps bridge the gap between business objectives and IT service delivery.
   

  

  

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 Full-time assignment (100%).
   

  

 On-site presence may be required according to client policy.
   

  

 English is the primary working language.
   

  

 The role is focused on business relationship management, governance, stakeholder engagement, service agreements, SLA management, escalation ownership, and financial transparency rather than operational delivery ownership.
   

  

  

 ﻿Required skills
   

 Stakeholder Management
   

 Business & Technology Collaboration
   

 Service Governance & SLA Management
   

 Demand Management
   

 Product & Service Landscape Understanding
   

 financial governance
   

 IT Governance
   

 Preferred skills
   

 Swedish
   

 Languages
   

 English
   

 (Proficient)

title: Customer Engineer, AI Natives, Junior Talent Programme
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related STEM discipline (e.g., Computer Engineering, Information Systems), or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience programming or scripting in one or more modern languages (e.g., Python, Go, Java, C++) with experience in fundamental Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA).
* Experience working with databases (SQL or NoSQL), web technologies (APIs, HTTP), or cloud infrastructure through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional experience.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience participating in hackathons, contributing to open-source projects, or building and deploying personal applications/tools.
* Experience working with Large Language Model (LLM) APIs, prompt engineering, vector databases, or building basic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications or simple conversational agents.
* Experience communicating technical concepts clearly to different audiences.
* Experience working in collaborative environments (such as team projects, customer service, or technical residency programs) with an ability to adapt quickly to changing customer needs and new technical domains.
* Strong debugging skills and familiarity with configuring developer environments (e.g., using Docker or basic Linux command line tools).


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 Securing engineering talent in the agentic era requires a highly targeted approach that prioritizes direct capability and technical curiosity.
   

  

 As a Customer Engineer (CE), you will play a pivotal role in supporting the pre-sales lifecycle and technical validation phases. You will act as an early-career builder-CE establishing credibility and excitement by assembling, debugging, and spinning up rapid, real-time prototypes and interactive demos directly for customers.
   

  

 In this role, you will partner closely with senior CEs and Sales teams to understand customer environments, map out their technical needs, and showcase the art of the possible across the full Google Cloud portfolio. As an AI-savvy, professional who is adept at leveraging AI tools, you will address all platform CE topics across the entire portfolio.Your primary focus is supporting the technical win through customer intimacy, architecture advisory and execution. By maintaining a strong builder mindset, you will write clean demo code, troubleshoot API integrations, and help transition projects to post-sales teams to ensure customer workloads are successfully deployed and adopted.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

 Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
   

  

 Sweden: kr680000 - kr695000 (SEK) + 42.86% bonus target + equity + benefits
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Learn more about benefits at Google .
   

  

* Help build creative solutions to challenging customer needs using Google Cloud. Improve product feature offerings by providing customer feedback to internal cross-functional teams including Product Management and Engineering.
* Collaborate with customers and other Googlers to manage and drive successful adoption of Google Cloud. Help develop recommendations for solution architectures and consulting services.
* Guide customers through the entire innovation lifecycle, building strategic roadmaps and driving achievement of key milestones.
* Solve customers operational issues through problem solving and technical troubleshooting, while working with internal teams to drive resolution. Help customers get answers to product questions.
* Learn and adopt the latest AI, machine learning, and cloud technologies. Gather feedback from builders and developers in the field and share insights with Google Cloud Product and Engineering teams to help improve our developer tools.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Linuxtekniker till Regeringskansliet
description:
**Sektionen Datacenter och plattformar, Digitaliseringsavdelningen**
 Regeringskansliet befinner sig i en spännande digital förnyelse där vi utvecklar och moderniserar våra tekniska plattformar för att möta framtidens behov.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en eller flera engagerade Linuxtekniker som vill vara med på resan och bidra med sin kompetens i en verksamhet med höga ambitioner och stort samhällsvärde. Hos oss får du arbeta med drift, utveckling och förvaltning av en avancerad Linuxmiljö i händelsernas centrum, där din insats är viktig och gör skillnad varje dag.
   

  

 Din arbetsdag. Sveriges morgondag.
   

  

 Som IT-tekniker på sektionen Datacenter och plattformar ingår du i ett team som har ansvar för drift, förvaltning och utveckling av en global och komplex IT-miljö med högt ställda kontinuitets- och säkerhetskrav. Teamets, och även ditt, ansvar omfattar servervirtualiseringsplattformen, lagring, backup, windowsserver drift, underhåll och utveckling av Linuxservermiljön.
   

  

 Regeringskansliet står inför en spännande framtid med en framåtlutad digitaliseringsstrategi, vilket innebär att vi utvecklar våra arbetssätt för att möta digitaliseringen. Det ställer krav på robusta och säkra lösningar med hög tillgänglighet.
   

  

 Läs mer om vår verksamhet på www.regeringen.se
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 I din roll ingår även att arbeta med förbättringsåtgärder och utveckling inom området och att hålla dig uppdaterad på teknikområdet genom omvärldsbevakning. Du kommer arbeta i projekt där du deltar både som teknisk rådgivare samt som utförare. Du kommer tillsammans med dina kollegor i teamet säkerställa en god drift och nyutveckling av de förmågor som övriga tekniska team behöver för att leverera ett modernt IT-stöd. Det innebär bland annat att dokumentera lösningar och ta fram nya rutiner, implementera och vidareutveckla nya lösningar, till exempel inom automation.
   

  

 Din bakgrund
   

  

 För att vara aktuell för denna roll behöver du uppfylla alla skallkrav och gärna även de meriterande kriterierna.
   

  

**Krav**
* Högskoleutbildning eller annan eftergymnasial utbildning inom för tjänsten relevant område.
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av drift, underhåll och installation av Linuxbaserad serverinfrastruktur i virtualiserade och fysiska datacenter/miljöer.
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av Linux, exempelvis:
+ Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
+ Debian
+ Ubuntu

* Arbetslivserfarenhet av säkerhetshärdning av Linuxmiljöer.
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av automation och konfigurationshantering, exempelvis: Ansible, Puppet, Terraform, Chef eller motsvarande verktyg.
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av övervakningssystem, exempelvis Zabbix
* God erfarenhet av dokumentation.
* Erfarenhet av analysarbete och proaktiv felsökning.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


**Meriterande**
* Gitops /Devops
* Backup lösningar
* Containerteknik samt orkestrering
* Cloudmiljöer
* Eposthantering i linuxmiljö
* Windows Server
* Lagringslösningar
* Databaser som exempelvis mySQL/postgres


 Dina egenskaper
   

  

 Regeringskansliets medarbetarkriterier är helhet, utveckling, resultat. Alla som arbetar i Regeringskansliet behöver ha helhetssyn och samarbeta för verksamhetens bästa. Du förväntas bidra med ditt perspektiv och din kompetens samt vara öppen för andras. Du kommer med idéer och nya angreppssätt för att förbättra och utveckla verksamheten och din egen kompetens. Du är inriktad på resultat i ditt agerande och anpassar dig när behov och inriktning ändras.
   

  

 Din problemlösande och analytiska förmåga gör att du snabbt kan sätta dig in i komplexa situationer och hitta välavvägda lösningar. Du har en prestigelös inställning och samarbetar gärna med andra för att nå bästa möjliga resultat. Du tar ansvar, visar initiativ och anpassar dig när behoven skiftar – alltid med fokus på att skapa stabila, säkra och hållbara lösningar som gör verklig skillnad.
   

  

 Läs mer på Medarbetarskap och ledarskap i Regeringskansliet - Regeringen.se
   

  

 Övrigt
   

  

 Annonsen avser en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med sex månaders provanställning.
   

 Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
   

 Beredskapsarbete utanför ordinarie arbetstid kan förekomma.
   

 Befattningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass och en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas. Du måste vara svensk medborgare, men får gärna ha utländsk bakgrund.
   

  

 Är du intresserad?
   

  

 För mer information om tjänsten och våra erbjudanden, vänligen kontakta Anton Berglie, sektionschef för Datacenter och plattformar. Våra fackliga representanter är Johan Strokirk (Saco) och Jan Wahlström (ST). Samtliga nås via Regeringskansliets växel på telefonnummer 08-405 10 00.
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan
 **senast den 31 augusti.**

title: Finance Systems Manager
description:
**About The Role**
 LeoVegas Group is seeking a highly capable and hands-on Finance System Manager to own the development and continuous improvement of our Finance Systems landscape.
   

  

 The successful candidate will become the primary in-house expert for NetSuite and will be responsible for designing, building, configuring and deploying Finance Systems enhancements. This role combines strong NetSuite technical expertise with solid Finance domain knowledge to translate business requirements into scalable system solutions.
   

  

 You will act as a bridge between Finance, Technology, and external partners, driving continuous improvement across key finance processes, support ongoing finance system implementations / enhancements.
   

  

 You will report directly to the Head of Finance Transformation and work closely with the rest of the Finance team and other stakeholders. We are looking for someone to join our global team and can be placed either at the Stockholm office, Sweden or at the office in Sliema, Malta. We expect you to travel to our different locations when needed.
   

  

**You Will Be Responsible For**
* Drive initiatives to perform enhancements to optimize the critical financial systems, ensuring alignment with Finance and company goals.
* Own and manage NetSuite as the primary Finance ERP platform.
* Act as technical owner for other Finance Systems, including Workday Adaptive Planning and other supporting Finance applications.
* Explore AI solutions within the Netsuite environment and cross platform relationships, to improve efficiency
* Work directly with Finance stakeholders to scope, challenge and refine requirements.
* Translate Finance and Accounting requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Develop and maintain SuiteScript customisations, workflows, saved searches, dashboards and reports.
* Build and maintain integrations between NetSuite and other business systems.
* Lead release management and testing cycles
* Troubleshoot and resolve system issues.
* Ensure system configuration supports financial controls, segregation of duties, and audit requirements across all entities.
* Maintain clear documentation, including configuration runbooks, access control logs, and change records
* Drive automation and standardisation across entities
* Identify inefficiencies and implement scalable solutions
* Manage roles, permissions, workflows, and system integrity
* Manage external NetSuite partners and ensure cost-efficient use of consultants


**Essential Skills**
**OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:**
* 5+ years of hands-on NetSuite experience.
* Strong experience with SuiteScript, SuiteFlow and NetSuite customisation.
* Experience designing and implementing ERP enhancements independently.
* Good understanding of Finance and Accounting processes.
* Experience supporting Accounting, Financial Reporting and FP&A functions.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Structured and governance-oriented


 NICE TO HAVES
   

  

* NetSuite Administrator certification.
* Adaptive Planning experience.
* SQL and API integration experience.
* Experience working with reporting and analytics platforms.
* Background in financial controls, internal audit or compliance-driven environments
* Experience in a multi-entity international business.
* Experience within online gaming, technology or other fast-growing digital businesses.
* Exposure to integrations (APIs, middleware)
* SuiteScript


**Who We Are**
 At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 18 offices worldwide.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Hybrid work policy
* 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
* 30 annual vacation days
* Occupational Pension
* 5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually
* Parental Leave Top-Up
* Possibility to enrol in a private health care insurance for both you and your partner
* 1,500 SEK equipment allowance
* Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts


**JOIN US!**
 In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!
   

  

 Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!
   

  

**As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please**

title: IT-säkerhetsspecialist – Etisk hackare
description:
**Om tjänsten** 




 Som Etisk hackare arbetar du med teknisk säkerhetsgranskning och penetrationstestning för att stärka Svenska kraftnäts motståndskraft mot cyberangrepp. Du bidrar till att stärka säkerheten i en av Sveriges mest samhällskritiska verksamheter genom att identifiera sårbarheter, utveckla testmetoder och förbättra den tekniska säkerhetsförmågan.
 



  





 Du arbetar i varierande IT- och OT-miljöer där du säkerhetsgranskar allt från moderna containerbaserade utvecklingsmiljöer till ICS-/SCADA-miljöer. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med andra IT-säkerhetsspecialister och ger dig möjlighet att bidra till utvecklingen av Svenska kraftnäts tekniska säkerhetsförmåga.- Teknisk granskning/penetrationstestning av nya system.
 



  





**Tjänsten innebär bland annat att:** 



* Genomföra teknisk säkerhetsgranskning och penetrationstestning av nya system.
* Genomföra teknisk säkerhetsgranskning och penetrationstestning utifrån Red Team-scenarier.
* Utveckla testmetoder och verktyg för penetrationstestning.
* Genomföra sårbarhetsscanning för att identifiera och validera sårbarheter.
* Arbeta med IT-säkerhetsincidenter inom ramen för Svenska kraftnäts C-SIRT.
* Vara med och utveckla granskningsmetoder, processer, verktyg och automation



  





 Hos oss får du möjlighet att växa och utvecklas som penetrationstestare i en kreativ miljö tillsammans med många erfarna och engagerade kollegor. Vi fäster stor vikt vid personlig utveckling och kompetensutveckling. På IT-säkerhetsavdelningen arbetar omkring 50 specialister inom olika områden av IT- och cybersäkerhet, vilket ger goda möjligheter att utvecklas i många olika riktningar och bredda din kompetens.
 



  





 Du är placerad på enheten Operativ IT-säkerhet, som är en del av Svenska kraftnäts IT-säkerhetsavdelning. Enheten består av cirka 15 specialister inom säkerhetsövervakning (SOC), säkerhetsanalys, teknisk säkerhetsgranskning, forensisk analys, incidenthantering och threat intelligence. Här arbetar du tillsammans med engagerade kollegor i en miljö som präglas av kunskapsdelning, teknisk utveckling och ett gemensamt fokus på att möta dagens och morgondagens cyberhot.
 



  





**Om dig** 




**Skallkrav:** 




 Personliga egenskaper:
 



 Vi söker dig som är analytisk, kreativ och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs med att analysera komplexa tekniska miljöer och motiveras av att lösa avancerade tekniska utmaningar.
 



  





 Du ska också leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden.
 



  





 I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
 



  





 Utbildning:
 



 Du har en akademisk examen inom datavetenskap eller informationssäkerhet eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad på annat sätt som Svenska kraftnät bedömer likvärdig
 



  





 Du har även:
 


* Aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet av penetrationstestning/Red Teaming
* Avancerade kunskaper inom Linux- och Windowsbaserade miljöer.
* Goda kunskaper inom IT-infrastruktur, nätverk och IT-säkerhetslösningar.

 Vi ser det som

 Du når oss också via e-post: fornamn.efternamn@svk.se
 



 Jobba här – bli en viktig del av vår energiframtid | Svenska kraftnät

title: CloudOps Engineer
description:
Vi söker dig som vill ta nästa steg i karriären som CloudOps Engineer tillsammans med oss! I denna roll kommer du att vara avgörande för vår kunds infrastruktur, med fokus på Azure och M365. Du kommer att hantera allt från avancerade säkerhetskonfigurationer med Azure Defender och Microsoft Sentinel, till komplex nätverkskonfiguration i Azure VNet.
   

  

**Ansvarsområden**
 I rollen som CloudOps Engineer kommer du att ha ett brett ansvar för att säkerställa en högpresterande och säker infrastruktur. Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden inkluderar:
   

  

* Hybrid molninfrastruktur: Analysera och optimera hybridmiljöer för att identifiera och lösa flaskhalsar, vilket ökar produktivitet och operativ effektivitet.
* Säkerhet och drift: Ansvara för säkerhetskonfigurationer i Azure Defender, Microsoft Purview och Sentinel, samt säkerhetsfunktioner i M365 och Azure. Arbeta kontinuerligt med hotanalys och förbättringar för att skydda infrastrukturen.
* Nätverkskonfiguration: Arbeta med Azure VNet för att säkerställa säker och pålitlig kommunikation mellan IT-miljöer och tjänster.
* Effektivisering och innovation: Identifiera och driva automatisering och optimering inom driftprocesser, implementera nya teknologier för att höja säkerhet och operativ prestanda.
* Digitalisering: Leda teknisk utveckling och digitalisering av arbetsflöden, samt implementera molntjänster som API Management, Azure Functions och Kubernetes för skalbarhet.
* Samarbete och incidenthantering: Arbeta tvärfunktionellt och hantera incidenter, samt samordna med interna och externa partners för snabb återhämtning vid driftstörningar.


**Kvalifikationer**
* Erfarenhet inom CloudOps eller liknande roller, med kunskaper inom Azure och M365 säkerhetsfunktioner.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med komplexa molnmiljöer och hybridlösningar.
* Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och som del av ett team, med stark problemlösningsförmåga och analytiskt tänkande.
* Behärskar Svenska och Engelska flytande i både tal och skrift.


**Meriterande**
* Certifieringar såsom Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Security Engineer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect eller liknande.


**Om CONSULTING It**
 När du börjar hos oss som konsult på CONSULTING it blir du en del av vår gemenskap. Du får dessutom kollegor runt om i Sverige! Du har en dedikerad konsultchef som stöttar dig och din utveckling. Vi hjälper dig hitta nya vägar genom att prova på nya roller och nya branscher, för oss är det viktigt att du trivs på din arbetsplats. Vi ser till att du hamnar på ett bra bolag under ditt uppdrag och att uppdragen ligger i linje med hur du vill utvecklas framöver. Oavsett vad det blir, står vi bakom dig hela vägen – i ditt nästa, nästa och nästa steg. Gå med i vårt team och ta del av en spännande och utvecklande arbetsmiljö!

title: Linux Engineer
description:
Är du en erfaren Linuxspecialist som vill arbeta i en modern hybrid IT-miljö där klientplattformar, molntjänster och säkerhet möts? Trivs du med att kombinera teknisk problemlösning, automation och förvaltning med kontinuerlig utveckling av stabila och säkra lösningar? Då kan detta vara rätt uppdrag för dig.
 



  





 Vi söker nu en självgående och tekniskt driven konsult med djup kompetens inom Linuxbaserade klientmiljöer. Du kommer att arbeta i en komplex och verksamhetskritisk IT-miljö där fokus ligger på att utveckla, förvalta och effektivisera Linuxklienter och tillhörande lösningar i både Azure och AWS.
 



  





 Om uppdraget
 



 I rollen kommer du att vara en viktig del av arbetet med att säkerställa stabila, säkra och moderna klientplattformar. Du arbetar brett med konfiguration, felsökning, automation och livscykelhantering samt bidrar till utvecklingen av framtida lösningar och arbetssätt.
 



 Du kommer att samarbeta nära team inom klienthantering, cloud, infrastruktur och säkerhet, vilket kräver både teknisk bredd och god samarbetsförmåga.
 



  





 Arbetsuppgifter
 



 Som Linux Client Specialist kommer du bland annat att:
 


* Förvalta och vidareutveckla Linuxbaserade klientlösningar
* Arbeta med konfiguration, felsökning och livscykelhantering av Linuxklienter
* Bidra till automation, standardisering och effektivisering av Linuxmiljön
* Arbeta med Linuxrelaterade lösningar och integrationer i Azure och AWS
* Säkerställa att lösningar följer säkerhetskrav, tekniska riktlinjer och etablerade processer
* Samarbeta med team inom klientplattformar, cloud, infrastruktur och säkerhet
* Dokumentera tekniska lösningar, rutiner och beroenden
* Bidra till hög tillgänglighet, stabilitet och säkerhet i klient- och plattformsmiljöer



  





 Vi söker dig som har
 



 Obligatoriska kompetenser
 


* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av Linux, exempelvis Ubuntu, Red Hat, Debian eller motsvarande distributioner
* Praktisk erfarenhet av Linuxbaserade klientmiljöer
* Erfarenhet av konfiguration, felsökning och livscykelhantering inom Linux
* Erfarenhet av scripting eller automation, exempelvis Bash eller Python
* Kunskap och erfarenhet av Azure
* Kunskap och erfarenhet av AWS
* Grundläggande förståelse för IT-säkerhet i Linux- och molnmiljöer
* Erfarenhet av teknisk dokumentation
* God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt



  





 Meriterande kompetenser
 



 Det är extra meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:
 


* Drift, integration eller automation av Linuxlösningar i Azure och AWS
* Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform
* Konfigurationshantering, såsom Ansible
* Containertekniker som Docker eller Kubernetes

title: NDR Product Specialist
description:
**Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for an** 
**NDR Product Specialist** 
**to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Managed Services domain.**
**About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company**
 Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
   

  

 Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
   

  

 Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for an NDR Product Specialist to our Product team, who wants to make a difference in our Managed Security Services domain.
   

  

**The Role**
 Join our Product Specialist team as an NDR Specialist, where you’ll take ownership of the technical landscape across our network detection and response capabilities. This hybrid role blends deep cyber security expertise with both internal and external enablement, ensuring our NDR platforms are optimally configured, continuously improved, and fully leveraged by our Security Operations teams and our customers. You will work primarily with Vectra and Darktrace to strengthen detection coverage, improve response workflows, and drive operational value from our NDR service offering.
   

  

 In this role, you will:
   

  

* Act as the technical platform specialist for NDR solutions, with a focus on Vectra and Darktrace, including deployment strategies, use case development, detection tuning, and operational best practices.
* Monitor, assess, and communicate product updates, new capabilities, and roadmap changes from NDR vendors to ensure our detection capabilities remain effective and relevant.
* Enable and educate – share your expertise by keeping SOC analysts and internal stakeholders up to date on NDR platform developments, detection opportunities, and best practices. Translate technical changes into actionable guidance and ensure knowledge is embedded in our processes.
* Work closely with vendors, engineering teams, and internal stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, optimize deployments, and increase detection and response capabilities, representing the Product team with clarity and credibility.
* Drive ongoing enhancements across our NDR tooling and processes, ensuring that new platform capabilities are rapidly and effectively integrated into our managed detection service.


**Your Potential Background**
 We are looking for someone with a passion for cybersecurity, a strong sense of product ownership, and a collaborative mindset. You thrive in a dynamic environment, are eager to stay current with the latest developments in network detection and response, and enjoy sharing your expertise with others. You have 2-5 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, ideally as a product specialist within NDR, a technical account manager, a detection engineer, or in a similar role within a SOC or MSSP environment.
   

  

**Required Skills:**
* Deep familiarity with NDR platforms, including deployment strategies, detection engineering, and advanced technical capabilities within tools such as Vectra and Darktrace.
* Experience with operationalizing NDR solutions in enterprise, SOC, or MSSP environments.
* Strong interest in technical product ownership, with a proactive approach to learning and staying current with evolving NDR features, detection methods, and best practices.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative and outgoing personality; comfortable representing the team in cross-functional meetings, vendor dialogues, and technical customer discussions.
* Self-motivated, with a proven ability to work independently.


**Bonus points if you have:**
* Knowledge of vendor licensing models, service packaging, or commercial considerations related to NDR platforms.
* Experience writing detection rules, configuring automated workflows, integrating APIs, or tuning detections within Vectra, Darktrace, or similar NDR platforms.
* Relevant cybersecurity certifications or equivalent practical experience in network security, threat detection, or security operations.
* Previous experience working in a SOC or MSSP environment.


*Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Swedish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Swedish work permit.*
**Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future**
 If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.
   

  

 So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

title: Platform Consultant - Stockholm
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

 Our Enterprise and Strategic clients are among the most demanding legal teams in the world, and they expect a team that is prepared, consistent, and technically deep. In legal services, an error or a delayed response carries consequences beyond a frustrated customer: deadlines are fixed, privilege is non-negotiable, and the trust clients place in Legora reflects the trust they carry for their own clients. As a
 **Platform Consultant** 
 , you are part of that global dedicated team, owning issues end-to-end and holding the enterprise readiness standard across every handoff. This is a high-judgment, high-craft seat, and an early one, so you will help build the function as you run it.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Own it end-to-end: Take ownership of Enterprise and Strategic Premium issues from first signal to resolution. Maintain clean handoffs across a global team so clients experience continuity and enterprise-grade consistency, regardless of time zone or shift.
* Master the platform: Build deep expertise across Legora, including Assistant, Tabular Review, Workflows, Editor, and the Word Add-in, to diagnose and resolve complex, high-impact issues that demand structured thinking and sound judgment.
* Communicate with authority: Translate technical detail into concise, confident guidance for demanding professional users, and guide legal teams through complex workflows.
* Resolve first: Own every issue to resolution before escalating. When escalation is the right call, route to the Technical Platform Expert or Principal Platform Advisor with complete diagnostics, clear impact, and a recommended path. Not a hand-off that creates more work.
* Drive improvements: Spot recurring issues and user pain points, and partner with Product, Engineering, and Legal Engineering to fix them at the source. Produce reusable artifacts (playbook sections, troubleshooting guides, resolution templates) that raise the team's baseline.
* Set the standard: The way you handle enterprise readiness, escalation precision, and handoff quality today becomes the benchmark the team scales from.
* Cover the clock: Own your share of the global handoff rhythm. When you come on, pick up open issues with full context. When you hand off, leave nothing ambiguous. Enterprise clients should never feel the seams between regions.


 What you bring
   

  

* You have owned complex, high-stakes B2B relationships and consistently delivered exceptional outcomes for demanding professional clients.
* You turn frustrated users into advocates, and you take pride in the quality of every resolution.
* You notice patterns, surface issues before they escalate, and collaborate across functions to fix them for good.
* You are technically curious, learn new software quickly, and explain hard concepts simply.
* You write clearly under pressure: crisp updates with confirmed facts, named owners, and next steps, without speculation.
* You are fluent with support tooling such as Intercom, Zendesk, or similar platforms.
* A background in SaaS, AI, or legal tech is a strong plus.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

* Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across regions, on work that crosses every major legal market.
* Meaningful work: Your work shapes how the world’s leading legal teams adopt AI day to day.
* Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and the tools to do your best work.
* In-person environment: A workspace built for ambitious builders.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Head of B2B Delivery Operations
description:
At Tele2, we challenge the telecom industry to create more valuable solutions for our customers. Guided by our challenger mindset, we deliver high-quality connectivity and digital services, ranging from mobile and fixed networks to TV, streaming and global IoT.
   

  

 Sustainability is an integral part of how we work. Tele2 has been recognized as a climate leader in Europe by the Financial Times and named Sweden’s most sustainable company, reflecting our long-term commitment to reducing our environmental impact and advancing circular solutions together with our customers.
   

  

 Our values – Be Brave, Take Action, Make it Simple and Act Cost-efficiently – guide our culture, how we collaborate and how we turn ideas into action.
   

  

*We're looking for a leader to take full ownership of how we deliver operator services, from large, complex implementations through to service management and operations. You'll own the numbers that count: faster lead times, sharper delivery precision, higher NPS, and growing, profitable accounts. If you're a hands-on leader who thrives where great delivery meets real commercial impact, this one's for you.*
 At Tele2’s B2B unit (Business to Business), we work with a broad portfolio of IT and telecom products and services. We support customers of all sizes – from micro businesses to large enterprises and the public sector – helping them digitalize, secure and develop their business potential. As friendly experts, we combine deep expertise with a practical, customer-focused approach. Working in B2B means collaborating closely with our customers to create solutions that drive business value, strong customer experiences and sustainable growth.
   

  

**About The Job**
 As Head of Delivery Operations, you own the end-to-end delivery of all operator services across every customer segment. You lead the project management of large customer implementations and ensure that services go live efficiently, on time, and to a standard that keeps customers coming back. Your remit also covers service management, invoicing and administrative enablement, customer training, and the operations of Genesys Cloud.
   

  

 In this role you will:
   

  

* Lead the implementation of operator services in an efficient, repeatable way
* Project-manage large, complex customer implementations from contract to go-live
* Own service management for operator customers, driving customer satisfaction and add-on sales
* Build and maintain expertise in invoicing and administrative enablement
* Oversee customer training and the day-to-day operations of Genesys Cloud
* Take responsibility for the profitability of customers managed by your service managers


 You'll be measured on the things that matter to the business and the customer:
   

  

* Lead time: contract to cash, and order to cash
* Customer satisfaction (NPS)
* Delivery precision
* Add-on sales
* Credit notes
* Customer profitability across the service-managed portfolio


**Who are you?**
 To thrive and succeed in this role, we believe that you:
   

  

* Have proven leadership experience in delivery, operations, or service management, ideally within telecoms, or a comparable B2B environment
* Commercial mindset and customer-centric, with a track record of owning KPIs such as lead time, delivery precision, NPS and customer profitability
* Hands-on familiarity with driving efficiency and customer experience improving projects preferably leveraging AI


 Preferred qualifications:
   

  

* Bring solid project management experience leading large, complex customer implementations
* Experience with invoicing and administrative enablement processes


 You're a natural leader who builds trust quickly and gets the best from your team. You stay calm and structured when implementations get complex, and you keep both the customer and the commercials in view at the same time. You're driven by results, comfortable making decisions, and you genuinely enjoy turning satisfied customers into long-term, growing accounts.
   

  

**A few words from the manager**
*"You would be joining a close-knit team that takes pride in delivering value to our customers and supporting each other along the way. We move fast, we're honest with one another, and we celebrate the wins together. If you want real ownership, the chance to shape how we deliver, and a team that genuinely has your back, this is the place to do it. - Johanna Juhl, Director of B2B Operator"*
**Benefits**
 Pension and health care
   

  

 Hybrid and flexible work life balance
   

  

 Career opportunities
   

  

 Parental benefit
   

  

 Employee benefits and Tele2 discounts
   

  

 Inclusive workplace

title: Operations Analyst
description:
**Filed is building the first AI tax preparer trusted by America’s accounting firms.**
 This industry might seem boring—but it’s a $70B backbone of the economy that’s breaking under a talent shortage no one has solved. We’re fixing it—fast.
   

  

 In just 9 months, we’ve hit strong product-market fit, are generating insanely fast-growing, ridiculously sticky revenue, and are backed by top-tier investors. We’re not a tool—we’re the missing workforce firms have been sounding the alarm for. We’re building the future by expanding our already 30-person team with those who want to say “I was there when it all started.”
   

  

 Read more → TechCrunch
   

  

 ⸻
   

  

**What we should tell you about the role:**
 We’re looking for a
 **Business Operations Analyst** 
 who thrives on building order from chaos and loves improving the way a company operates. You’re the kind of person who spots inefficiencies, designs systems to eliminate them, and has the drive to implement solutions quickly. You know that a great internal process is invisible to most people—but game-changing for the team that depends on it.
   

  

 This is a
 **part-time role designed to fit alongside your studies** 
 —you set the number of hours you work each week, as long as you deliver on the outcomes.
   

  

 Your mission:
 ***Significantly improve our internal processes through automation and structure, speeding up reporting, ensuring we’re not missing anything, and delivering on our deadlines.***
 You’ll work closely with leadership, operations, and other departments to streamline workflows, unify data sources, and ensure that we’re moving at the speed our growth demands. You won’t just make systems more efficient—you’ll create leverage that compounds over time.
   

  

 ⸻
   

  

**Here’s why this is a terrible job:**
* This is not a job for someone who likes to move slow.
* We operate week to week with ruthless speed. Sometimes we’re going in the wrong direction, but more times than not we’re going in the right direction.
* If you need a few extra days to perfect a process document, chances are there’s already a handful of team members blocked behind you.
* We implement tools and automations fast—often testing in real time.
* You’ll be operating at the intersection of operations, reporting, and cross-team coordination.
* There are no clear answers. Just judgment calls, ambiguity, and constant input from every direction.
* You’ll ask yourself, is this really the work? It is. And it’s not for everyone.


 ⸻
   

  

**Here’s why it’s the best career choice you’ll make:**
* We’re building what tax pros call impossible. A product that behaves like a teammate, not just another tool.
* You’ll be paid above market for an internship, gain experience at a rocket-ship startup, and have full autonomy to make high-impact improvements.
* You’ll own systems end-to-end, from design to deployment.
* You’ll work with leadership daily and see the direct impact of your contributions on company-wide performance.
* We’ll tell you what needs to be achieved. How you get there is on you.
* You’ll be building a foundation that allows the company to scale without breaking.


 ⸻
   

  

**The teammate we’re looking for:**
* Thrives at solving operational inefficiencies and systems challenges
* Moves seamlessly between identifying problems, implementing solutions, and iterating quickly
* Excited by the challenge of making internal operations invisible (because they just work)
* No lone wolves — we need a collaborative operator
* Big bonus if you have experience implementing automation or AI agents in a work environment


 ⸻
   

  

**What you’ll be responsible for:**
* Assist leadership in establishing a single source of truth for our business and financial metrics that updates automatically with minimal manual intervention.
* Implement operational automations that save significant time while for operations.
* Support management with various ad-hoc tasks that substantially reduce workload across the company, freeing up time for management to focus on key tasks.


 ⸻
   

  

**Your hard skillset:**
* Currently enrolled at a prestigious university preferably with strong academic performance.
* Previous experience internships, or working in a small, fast-paced, and dynamic environment.
* Proficient in workplace tools, integrations, and automations—especially AI applications or AI agents—with demonstrated hands-on experience.
* Strong professional references.


 ⸻
   

  

**Your soft skillset:**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious — building for the team, not just for performance metrics
* Highly collaborative across departments and with leadership
* Detail-oriented but pragmatic — you know when polish matters and when to move
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


 ⸻
   

  

**Growth and Levels:**
* This isn’t a comfy operations internship. It’s fast, focused, and impact-obsessed.
* You will launch improvements fast. You will learn fast. You will own what you ship.
* Opportunity to transition into a full-time role based on performance.


 ⸻
   

  

**The process:**
* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Practical case study (60 minutes)
* Final round with our team (60 minutes)


 In just 2.5 hours, you’ll be wanting early access—just like the rest of our team—to get into the stack and start building a generational company, even before your first day. Because you’ll see the opportunity to change your career trajectory—fast.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Why Polar?**
--------------


It's never been easier to build, ship and scale software.


But it's never been harder to monetize it.


Modern startups look fundamentally different than prior generations:

* Smaller teams
* Exponential revenue growth relative to headcount
* Higher variability in costs (LLMs) requiring more frequent pricing iterations
* Laser focused on product development and distribution
* Delegating and automating everything that is boilerplate – be it in their codebase or business operations.


Exceptional billing primitives, APIs and SDKs are essential, but delightful integration is not enough.


Startups need a billing platform designed for their speed of iteration. Combining billing and analytics in one platform to offer customer- and feature unit economics in real-time. Offering built-in pricing and cost insights, simulations and optimizations while simultaneously handling international compliance, tax management, fraud prevention and more.


That's Polar. We're building the next standard for applied AI startups.


Join our small, talented and engineering-led team across Europe as we build the infrastructure powering the next generation of software companies.


We focus on shipping at high velocity to serve startup founders scale their businesses. Everything else is secondary.

**Role & responsibilities: What you will do**
---------------------------------------------


We’re hiring a **Senior Platform Engineer** to architect and evolve the Polar platform - ensuring the system remains fast, resilient and operationally sound as we scale.


Polar operates as a merchant of record, meaning our platform sits directly in the critical path of global payments, billing infrastructure and financial workflows. Reliability, uptime and correctness are essential - while still maintaining the ability to move quickly and ship product improvements.


You’ll work across the platform and infrastructure layers that power Polar - from core infrastructure and observability to deployment safety, internal tooling and reliability engineering. In close partnership with the team, you’ll ensure the system scales to handle increasing traffic, architectural complexity and regulatory demands without compromising stability, performance or developer velocity.


This role is ideal for someone who treats reliability as a product requirement and scalability as an architectural discipline, combining deep systems engineering experience with a passion for building reliable, scalable platforms and empowering engineering teams through strong abstractions and automation.


While this role focuses primarily on the foundational layers of our platform, we value engineers who are comfortable moving across the stack when needed to ship quickly and maintain momentum.


You’ll work with the team to:

* **Ensure Platform Reliability & Uptime:** Design and evolve systems that maintain high availability, predictable performance and operational stability. Drive improvements in uptime, resilience and operational discipline as the system scales.
* **Engineer for Scale & Performance:** Strengthen how our distributed services behave under load. Identify bottlenecks, optimize critical paths and design systems that scale with growing traffic and complexity.
* **Advance SRE & DevOps Practices:** Embed reliability engineering practices across the platform - defining SLOs and SLIs, improving incident response, reducing operational toil and making production behavior measurable and actionable.
* **Evolve Cloud & Infrastructure Systems:** Continuously evolve Polar’s infrastructure baseline and determine when the current stack needs to evolve. Improve infrastructure-as-code, environment management and operational safety mechanisms.
* **Strengthen Deployment & Operational Safety:** Refine CI/CD systems, rollout strategies and rollback mechanisms to ensure changes are safe, observable, reversible and fast to deploy.
* **Improve Observability & Debuggability:** Advance logging, metrics and tracing standards so engineers can quickly understand, debug and resolve issues in production.
* **Collaborate across Engineering, Risk & Legal:** Work closely with product and infrastructure engineers, as well as risk and legal stakeholders, to translate evolving regulatory requirements into clear technical abstractions while maintaining long-term platform reliability and health.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

**Systems Thinking & Operating Mindset**

* Deep systems thinking: You anticipate failure modes, design for idempotency and consistency, and think carefully about how distributed systems behave in production.
* Security- and compliance-aware engineering mindset: You build with auditability, principled access control and regulatory constraints as first-order design considerations.
* End-to-end ownership: You are comfortable owning features from infrastructure and backend systems all the way to shipping functionality that powers the product. While this role focuses on platform layers, we value engineers willing to work across the stack when needed.
* Strong product judgement: You know when to move fast while ensuring that correctness, auditability and long-term system integrity take precedence.
* High-ownership collaboration: You thrive in small teams, collaborating closely across engineering to evolve the platform architecture and take shared responsibility for the long-term health of the system.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong backend expertise - you design clear, durable APIs and build systems that are resilient under real-world load and edge cases.
* Highly proficient in SQL and data modeling - you reason rigorously about long-term data correctness, performance and reliability across large datasets.
* Strong production debugging and observability instincts with an ability to trace complex issues across services and understand how to prevent them in the future.
* Experience building or operating distributed systems with strong reliability and operational requirements.

**Experience**

* 5-8+ years of engineering experience, building and scaling customer-facing SaaS or fintech products in a high-growth environment.
* Experience in payments and billing infrastructure - subscription lifecycles, transaction orchestration, refunds/disputes, payouts and financial state management.


Nice-to-have: Open source contributions or side projects/apps to showcase.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Meaningful ownership: Small team & large surface area. You’ll directly influence how the company and platform scale.
* Product-driven culture: We build to empower the next generation of software companies - and operate with the same builder mindset internally.
* Competitive compensation: Salary and equity aligned with the impact of the role.
* Exceptional team: Work with highly talented team members distributed across Europe.
* Remote-first environment: Work from anywhere in Europe, with a home office setup budget available.
* Annual team offsites: As the team is spread across Europe, we gather in person at least once a year to collaborate, plan, and spend time.
* Health Benefits: Comprehensive health coverage to support you and your family.
* Parental leave: Paid parental leave aligned with the standards and regulations of your local jurisdiction.

**How We Hire**
---------------


Polar is a remote-first company, with team members across Europe, and our hiring process is fully remote via video calls and email.

**Hiring Process**
------------------

* Application Review: We review your application and previous work.
* Intro call: A short conversation with Birk (Founder and CEO) to learn more about you and give you a chance to learn more about Polar.
* Take-home Assignment: A practical exercise designed to reflect the kind of problems you would work on in the role.
* Assignment Review: We review your assignment and feedback together
* Team Conversations: 2-3 video calls where you get the chance to meet future team members.
* Offer
* Reference Calls

description:
SAVR is a fast-growing Swedish fintech company on a mission to reinvent investing. We empower investors with a platform that offers
 **lower fees** 
 ,
 **greater transparency** 
 , and a
 **radically improved experience** 
 .
 



  





 We’re not just building another investment service — we’re reimagining how financial products should work for people, not just institutions. As part of our ambitious, innovative and curious team, you’ll help shape the future of investing in Sweden and beyond.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As a Senior Platform Engineer at SAVR, you will be part of our tech organization helping build and evolve the next generation investment platform. Your primary focus will be on designing, improving and operating our cloud platform, enabling our engineering teams to build, deploy and run services efficiently and securely. While this role is centered around infrastructure and platform engineering, you'll occasionally contribute to backend services and integrations where it creates the most value.
 



  





 You'll collaborate closely with Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Product Designers and Product Managers to build scalable solutions and continuously improve our developer experience. Our infrastructure is built on AWS and managed through Terraform, with CI/CD powered by GitHub Actions, alongside some GCP and a handful of third-party services. Our services are built in Kotlin, PHP and Python and run on ECS, with data in Aurora, PostgreSQL and Snowflake.
 



  





 As we continue to grow, so does the need for a cloud platform that is reliable, secure, observable and enjoyable to build on—and that's where you come in.
 



  





**Your Mission** 



* Own and evolve our AWS platform, including networking, infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, observability, backups, cloud governance and cost optimization.
* Drive technical improvements across cloud architecture, CI/CD, automation, developer experience and operational tooling, reducing toil through smart tooling and abstractions.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams to build cloud-native solutions, integrations and infrastructure that enable product development.
* Support backend teams with infrastructure expertise and occasionally contribute to application development when needed.
* Monitor, troubleshoot and optimize cloud environments for performance, reliability, security and cost efficiency.
* Foster our learning culture by actively participating in feedback sessions, both receiving and providing constructive feedback on code and infrastructure changes.



  





**You’ll Thrive in This Role If You...** 



* Are a Platform Engineer or Software Engineer with strong experience building and operating cloud platforms.
* Have solid experience with AWS, Terraform, CI/CD, Docker, ECS and/or EKS, and observability tooling.
* Have 5+ years of professional experience designing, building and operating cloud-based systems in production environments.
* Enjoy working in a startup environment where you can take ownership, solve a wide range of technical challenges and collaborate across disciplines.
* Care about automation, operational excellence and building reliable systems that scale.
* Have some backend development experience and enjoy working closely with application engineers.
* Are fluent in English and either hold Swedish citizenship or a valid EU work permit (visa sponsorship is unfortunately not available).



  





**Our Cultural DNA** 




 🧠
 **Open-minded** 
 – we embrace new ideas, diverse perspectives, and continuous learning
 



 🚀
 **Bold** 
 – we take smart risks, move fast, and aren’t afraid to fail forward
 



 🤝
 **Honest** 
 – we value transparency, feedback, and doing the right thing
 



 We’re a startup, so things can be a little messy — and that’s part of the thrill. If you thrive in building as a team and handling uncertainty, you will fit right in.
 



  





**What’s In It for You** 




 You’ll join a product- and design-driven company where your work has real impact. We keep things lean, move fast, and genuinely care about the experience we deliver — for customers and for each other.
 



  





 Here’s what we offer:
 



 💻 Top-tier work gear
 



 💰 Competitive salary
 



 🏃 ♀️ Generous wellness allowance
 



 🤒 Insurance package
 



 🌱 Occupational pension and long-term savings support
 



 🏢
 *Office-first approach* 
 to foster collaboration and quick decision-making — with flexibility when you need it (4+1)
 



 🥗
 *Stocked pantry* 
 , plus regular social gatherings and wellness activities to keep energy and culture high
 



  





**Our Commitment to Diversity** 




 SAVR is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We believe diverse teams build better products and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.'
 



  





**Ready to Join Us?** 




 We’d love to hear from you. Apply now or reach out with any questions — and let’s build something meaningful together.
