title: AI Transformation Architect EMEA
description:
**About Unframe**
 Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.
   

  

 With over $100M in TCV secured within 12 months, and a $50M Series B led by Highland Europe, Unframe is rapidly scaling globally alongside Fortune 500 customers, backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a AI Transformation Architect at Unframe, you’ll be the first technical voice a prospect hears. You’ll join early conversations, showcase real solutions built on Unframe, and help potential customers connect the dots between their needs and our platform. You’ll demo AI-powered use cases across multiple industries - from finance to cybersecurity to operations - and guide technical discovery to help prospects envision what’s possible.
   

  

 This is a high-impact, outward-facing role at the intersection of Sales, Product and Marketing.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Join early-stage calls with Strategic Account Executives to lead technical discovery and demos.
* Deliver compelling live demos tailored to customer pain points and use cases.
* Translate customer pain points into relevant AI-powered solution examples.
* Communicate the value and architecture of Unframe clearly and confidently.
* Build credibility and trust with prospects while becoming a strategic partner in shaping their AI vision.
* Share insights with Product, Marketing, and R&D teams based on real-world conversations.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 5+ years experience in solutions engineering, technical pre-sales, or product management.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software, APIs, and modern cloud platforms.
* Confident presenting technical products to both business and technical audiences.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Curious, collaborative, and customer-obsessed — you know how to ask the right questions and build strong relationships.


**Why join us?**
 You’ll help some of the world’s leading companies understand and adopt AI in real, practical ways. You’ll work directly with enterprise customers, lead meaningful technical conversations, and help shape how our platform is experienced in the market. You’ll have real ownership, work closely with Product, Sales, and R&D, and play a key role in building what comes next in one of the fastest-moving spaces in tech.

title: Client Executive
description:
Drivs du av att göra affärer och bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer? Vill du arbeta nära företag i deras utveckling och vara med och forma skräddarsydda finansieringslösningar? Nu söker vi en Client executive till vårt Corporate-team i Stockholm.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som kundansvarig på Norion Bank arbetar du med medelstora företag och ansvarar för att bygga upp och utveckla en egen kundportfölj. Du arbetar nära kundernas ledning och ägare, identifierar finansieringsbehov och driver hela kreditprocessen – från första kontakt till uppföljning.
   

  

 Du erbjuds en affärsnära roll med stort eget ansvar, där du kombinerar relationsbyggande med analys och affärsmässighet.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
* Prospektera och etablera nya kundrelationer
* Analysera kunders finansieringsbehov
* Strukturera och föreslå skräddarsydda finansieringslösningar
* Driva kreditprocessen: förhandling, kreditberedning och beslut
* Säkerställa avtal, utbetalning och administration
* Följa upp och utveckla befintliga kundrelationer


 Du arbetar i nära samarbete med funktioner som Kredit, Legal och Middle Office.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker dig som har ett starkt affärsdriv och trivs i en roll där du både skapar nya affärer och fördjupar befintliga relationer.
   

  

**Du har:**
* Högskoleexamen inom ekonomi eller motsvarande
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av kreditgivning till medelstora företag
* Erfarenhet av att driva affärer från första kontakt till genomförd affär
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska
* Erfarenhet av reskontrafinansiering/factoring.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från High yield organisation eller Debt advisory.
   

  

**För att lyckas i rollen är du:**
* Affärsdriven och målinriktad
* Relationsskapande och lyhörd
* Lösningsorienterad med god analytisk förmåga
* Bekväm i prospektering och nykundsbearbetning


**AFFÄRSOMRÅDET NORION BANK**
 Norion Bank är en affärsnära nordisk finansieringsbank, som är specialister på finansieringslösningar för medelstora företag och fastighetsbolag. Norion Bank erbjuder företags- och fastighetskrediter samt factoring och agerar som en stabil partner till bolag som vill ta nästa utvecklingssteg. Norion Bank finns på den svenska, norska, finska och tyska marknaden.
   

  

 I samtliga rekryteringsprocesser genomför Norion Bank bakgrundskontroller på slutkandidaten. Bakgrundskontrollen innefattar bland annat ekonomisk information, juridisk information och bosättningsuppgifter.
   

  

**REKRYTERINGSPROCESSEN**
 Norion Bank kommer att behandla dina personuppgifter i enlighet med gällande dataskyddslagstiftning. Läs mer om vår hantering av personuppgifter och dina rättigheter på https://karriar.norionbank.se/data-privacy
   

  

 Vi vill att vår rekryteringsprocess ska vara rättvis och inkluderande. Därför ber vi dig att inte bifoga foto eller annan information som inte är relevant för tjänsten. Personligt brev är inget krav.
   

  

**Vi undanber oss kontakt med rekryteringsbolag, konsultbolag samt annonsörer i rekryteringen.
   

  

 INTRESSERAD?**
 Kul! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande så ansök redan idag!
   

  

 Frågor? Välkommen att höra av dig till oss! För frågor kring teamet och rollen - kontakta gärna Anna Lannebo, Head of Corporate Stockholm på Anna.lannebo@norionbank.se.
   

  

 För frågor om oss som arbetsgivare eller rekryteringsprocessen kontakta gärna Teresa Åkemar, Chief HR Officer på teresa.akemar@norionbank.se.
   

  

 Norion Bank Group är en affärsnära nordisk finansieringsbank. Genom koncernens varumärken Norion Bank, Walley och Collector erbjuds kundanpassade finansieringstjänster som möter distinkta kundbehov inom tre kundsegment: medelstora företag och fastighetsbolag, handlare och privatpersoner. Som specialist på finansieringslösningar är Norion Bank Group ett ledande komplement till traditionella storbanker, med visionen att vara den främsta nordiska finansieringsbanken inom de utvalda segmenten.
   

  

  

  

 Norion Banks erbjudande omfattar företags- och fastighetskrediter samt factoring för medelstora företag och fastighetsbolag. Genom varumärket Walley erbjuds flexibla betal- och checkoutlösningar till handlare och privatpersoner. Varumärket Collector tillhandahåller privatlån och kreditkort till privatpersoner samt sparkonton för privatpersoner och företag. Norion Bank (tidigare Collector Bank) grundades 1999 och har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg, Oslo och Helsingfors. Verksamheten bedrivs genom Norion Bank AB (publ) som är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm.

title: Sales Director, Key Accounts
description:
We are looking for an experienced
 **Sales Director, Key Account** 
 to lead and develop the commercial operations of some of Stora Enso’s key customers as part of the Containerboard Business Area. The preferred location for this position is Helsinki, Finland but can also be other European location.
   

  

 This is a senior sales role with full accountability for commercial performance, customer value creation and profitable growth within our key customer segment. In this role you report to Head of Product & Sales Containerboard based in Helsinki.
   

  

 As Sales Director you have the overall responsibility for leading and developing the key customer relationships and building and implementing the account strategy and roadmap. You are responsible for the customer value proposition, key account priorities, pricing principles and sales resource allocation, ensuring a strong balance between growth, profitability and long‑term customer partnerships. You work closely with the sales teams to deepen customer understanding, expand relationships and systematically develop new business opportunities with both existing and new customers.
   

  

 The role requires close, hands‑on collaboration across functions including operations, supply chain, product development, marketing and finance. You drive commercial excellence through disciplined processes, performance management and fact‑based decision‑making, while actively pulling cross‑functional capabilities into the areas with the highest value‑creation potential.
   

  

 As a Sales Director within Containerboard, you will influence both short‑term business performance and long‑term strategic direction. This position offers an opportunity to shape the commercial agenda and make a tangible impact in a critical business segment within a global renewable materials company. You will act as the respected ambassador for Stora Enso in all customer interactions, from factory floor to CEO.
   

  

**About You**
 You are an accomplished and ambitious commercial leader with a proven ability to deliver results in complex, fast‑paced B2B environments. You combine strong strategic and systematic thinking with hands‑on execution and take full accountability for business performance.
   

  

 You have:
   

  

* A relevant university degree in Business, Economics, Finance or a related field (MBA or equivalent is an advantage)
* Proven senior‑level experience in sales with a strong track record of driving profitable growth and managing high‑value customer relationships
* Strong ambition and drive, with the resilience and stress tolerance required to succeed in demanding, results‑driven environments
* Strong business acumen, integrity and credibility, enabling sound decision‑making and trusted relationships with customers, teams and senior stakeholders
* Strong negotiation, communication and presentation skills, including the ability to influence and engage at executive level.
* A demonstrated ability to build constructive, long‑term relationships with customers and key internal and external stakeholders
* Willingness to travel as required
* You communicate fluently in English and if you speak French and/or German this is an advantage.


**Our offer**
 At Stora Enso, you will have the opportunity to make a real commercial and strategic impact in a key business segment within a global renewable materials company. In this role, you will shape the future of Containerboard business by driving customer value, commercial performance and sustainable growth.
   

  

 We value diversity, inclusion and different perspectives, and we believe they lead to better business outcomes. If you are excited about this role but do not meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply – your background and experience may be exactly what we are looking for.
   

  

 By joining us you will be part of diverse working culture supporting you to explore new perspectives and develop professionally. You will contribute towards a more sustainable world, as we believe that anything made from fossil-based materials today can be done from a tree tomorrow. To keep you going safely, we support your physical and mental wellbeing.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 You can submit your application only through our recruitment system.
   

  

 Please note that our team will be on summer holiday during July. We will review applications and get back to candidates in August. In the meantime, we warmly encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than
 **16th of August** 
 . We will start the interviews mid AugustWe will start the interviews mid August
   

  

 Depending on the position, we may ask you to complete tests. Our recruitment process may also include other pre‑employment activities such as background checks, reference checks, a health examination, and a drug test.
   

  

 If you have questions about the position, please contact the hiring manager Kristian Saelan Head of Product & Sales Containerboard and questions about the recruitment process can be directed to our Talent Acquisition Partner Veera Kaislasalo via email. Our email addresses are in the format firstname.lastname@storaenso.com.
   

  

**Welcome to the The renewable materials company!**
 Stora Enso is a global leader in renewable materials with a strong focus on packaging. Our purpose is to replace non-renewable materials with renewable solutions. Together with our customers, we design and deliver competitive, high-quality packaging materials and solutions, made from fresh and recycled fibers, accelerating the transition to a circular bioeconomy.

title: AI Adoption Consultant - Nordics
description:
**TLDR;** 
 Help European governments and regulated institutions deploy AI in a way that actually works. Enable actual societal value, and support organisations with their AI transformation.
   

  

**The challenge**
 Europe's public sector is understaffed and under pressure. Ageing populations, rising demand, flat budgets. AI is the only realistic way to build capacity without hiring millions of people. But deploying it inside a government ministry or public agency is not just the right tools, it’s change management and finding ways to build the right things and get people across the organisation onboard.
   

  

**About Intric**
 Intric is accelerating our growth, backed by new funding and strong demand from both existing and new customers.
   

  

 Our platform, Intric.ai, is transforming how work gets done – particularly within the public sector and among organizations that prioritize data sovereignty. We make advanced AI accessible, secure, and practical. Today, we hold a market-leading position within our niche, and we are continuing to scale across Europe. Now we are looking for an AI Adoption Consultant to join our team in Stockholm.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an AI Adoption Consultant, you play a critical role in ensuring our customers succeed with Intric. You are the bridge between our platform and the organizations that rely on it - rom the first identified need to a live, working assistant or agent.
   

  

 Your focus is not only on understanding customer needs, but on translating those needs into real, value-creating implementations. That means you sit down, build, test, and iterate. You'll construct AI assistants, agents, and automated flows directly in the customer's Intric environment. You'll manage change alongside it — but building is the core of the job.
   

  

 This is a hands-on role where you work closely with customers, internal teams, and subject-matter experts to ensure smooth onboarding, strong engagement, and long-term success. We're looking for someone with a get-it-done mentality who goes in, rolls up their sleeves, and doesn't leave until it works
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Work with ministries, agencies, and municipalities from first conversation through the point where people are using it every day.
   

  

* Build AI assistants, agents, and automated flows in Intric based on mapped customer needs
* Prototype, test, and iterate solutions directly in customer environments
* Scope and implement integrations where needed
* Lead the full delivery cycle — from need identification to production-ready solution
* Educate and enable customer staff to continue using and building on what you've delivered
* Analyze customer workflows and identify further opportunities for AI impact
* Collaborate with Adoption Specialists and internal product teams to drive successful outcomes


**Who You Are**
* 1–4 years at a top consulting firm (McKinsey, Bain, BCG or similar), or in a client-facing role at a fast-growing company
* Ability to understand how organizations actually work: where decisions live, how accountability flows
* Can explain what's technically possible and what the constraints are, in a way non-technical people actually get. Teacher's mindset!
* You see things through. You own the outcome.
* Can communicate complex ideas clearly and persuasively
* Fluent Swedish and English
* Genuine curiosity about how government and public institutions function
* Genuine interest in AI and how technology can improve real-world operations
* You are drawn to Intric’s mission to bring secure, sovereign, and easy-to-use AI to Europe’s most critical institutions


**Practical Information**
* Location: HQ in Stockholm
* Languages: English and Swedish (mandatory)


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary, commission and stock options
* 25 days of paid vacation
* Wellness allowance


**Culture at Intric**
 At Intric, we are building secure AI solutions for organizations that truly matter. We work with governments and institutions where quality, responsibility, and trust are non-negotiable.
   

  

 We expect ownership, high standards, and thoughtful execution. We continuously find ways to improve and test new things. We combine ambition with collaboration. We move fast, but we care deeply about doing things right. As we continue to scale across Europe, every team member plays an important role in shaping the company, and we look for smart, ambitious, and kind people to join our mission!

title: Account Executive
description:
**Company Description**
**Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR)** 
 is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and AI software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate. We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms.
   

  

 But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward-thinking, innovative force in the market.
   

  

 Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.
   

  

 Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.
   

  

 Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee, you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Description**
**The Role**
 Strategy is seeking a Senior Account Executive to drive strategic sales into enterprise accounts within his/her assigned territory. Responsibilities include prospecting, qualifying, selling, and closing new logo business into prospects and installed accounts. This is a new business hunter and individual contributor role with quota carrying responsibility. Whilst the focus is on new business development, there will be a split of approximately 70% new logo business together with 30% account development for existing customers. Hunter mentality, robust Pipeline Generation approach, experience with MEDDIC and Command of the Message.
   

  

**Your Focus**
* Drive complex, enterprise-wide sales cycles and effectively present Strategy’s value proposition to both C-level business and IT stakeholders through strategic value-led engagements
* Prospect, develop and close new business while creating satisfied and referenceable customers
* Research the customer environment to create effective business impact models, account plans and win plans; and create business cases, ROI and TCO models
* Manage all aspects of the sales process including lead generation, qualification, evaluation, close and account care, collaborating cross-functionally with Sales (Inside Sales, Sales Engineering), Marketing and Professional Services
* Work strategically with Inside Sales to develop a territory and target account plan to create a healthy pipeline that will yield overachievement in booking targets
* Manage an individual sales pipeline to ensure an appropriate mix of prospects, new business opportunities and firm proposals
* Balance long-term objectives with short term results to maximise overall revenue generation
* Meet and exceed direct sales goals within assigned territory
* Acquire and maintain a thorough working knowledge of Strategy’s Business Intelligence software products and services and a deep understanding of their applications
* Position Strategy’s solutions through strategic value-based selling, business case definition, return on investment analysis, customer references and analyst data
* Coordinate and manage industry events and user groups to generate market interest
* Ensure that all stages of the sales cycle are undertaken effectively to achieve the required results whilst adhering to Strategy’s chosen sales methodology - MEDDPICC
* Identify and manage risk in his/her business activities and take responsibility for reporting risks in a timely, open, and appropriate manner
* Prepare accurate sales forecasts and sales cycle reporting using Strategy’s CRM tool
* Leverage and enhance partner relationships to drive additional value and revenue


**Qualifications**
**Required Experience and Skills**
* 7+ years' experience of quota-carrying sales of software products and services into large enterprises
* Demonstrable track record of consistent over-quota sales performance
* Hunter mentality
* Strong Pipeline Generation (PG) approach
* Experience with MEDDIC and Command of the Message
* Hungry for success and driven to achieve high financial rewards
* Proven track record of senior level stakeholder engagement on complex IT and Business-led opportunities with referenceable client wins
* Extensive experience in prospecting, driving, and closing complex enterprise sales cycles
* Experience in areas such as Business Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, CRM, ERP, Cloud enterprise software sales
* Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively, network internally to get things done and be accountable for their decisions; ensuring all stages of sales cycle are running concurrently; opening pipe; progressing; closing deals; prioritizing tasks
* Demonstrable knowledge of key Return on Investment and Total Cost of Ownership principles
* A creative self-starter who can work effectively within a supportive team culture whilst independently managing their own business
* Ability to work in a fast paced, open, collaborative, and success-driven environment
* A strong storyteller with a customer-centric approach who can quickly build rapport
* Degree educated or equivalent academic/work experience


**Desirable Experience And Skills**
* Working knowledge of Business Intelligence competitor products, Data Preparation, ETL, Databases, Analytics and Enterprise Data Warehouses. Understanding of Big Data is preferred

title: Engineering Manager - Team Intelligence
description:
At Voyado, we’re building the intelligence layer that powers analytics, insights, and AI-driven experiences for retailers across Europe.
   

  

 We’re now looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Team Intelligence — a growing team of Analytics Engineers and Data Analysts responsible for analytics products, reporting capabilities, and the data foundations that enable trusted decision-making across our platform.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to combine people leadership with technical influence. Your primary mission will be to help the team grow and succeed, while also contributing to the technical direction of our analytics platform together with architects and senior engineers.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with Area Lead Robin Bodin, an experienced engineering leader, who will support you in both your leadership journey and the continued development of Team Intelligence. Whether you’re already an Engineering Manager or a Tech Lead ready to take your first step into formal people leadership, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Engineering Manager for Team Intelligence, you’ll lead a team working at the intersection of analytics, data and AI.
   

  

 You’ll be responsible for creating an environment where people can do their best work, ensuring sustainable delivery, and helping the team develop both their capabilities and ways of working. At the same time, you’ll stay close to the technology, supporting technical discussions and helping guide decisions around data products, analytics platforms, and modern data architecture.
   

  

 In this role, you will:
   

  

* Lead, coach, and support Analytics Engineers and Data Analysts through regular 1:1s, feedback, and development conversations.
* Create clarity around priorities, ownership and team ways of working.
* Partner with architects and area leads to help shape technical direction and long-term improvements.
* Support technical decision-making and help balance short-term delivery with long-term sustainability.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing engineering culture.
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders across the org.


 Who you are
   

  

 We’re looking for someone with a strong technical foundation and a genuine passion for helping teams succeed. As a leader, you’re someone who builds trust, encourages ownership, and creates an environment where people can do their best work. You’re curious, collaborative, and comfortable balancing long-term improvements with the realities of day-to-day delivery.
   

  

 Also someone who is comfortable navigating technical discussions and contributing to decisions around data products, analytics platforms, and modern data architecture. While this is first and foremost a leadership role, we believe great leadership in this environment comes from understanding the challenges your team faces and being able to provide both support and technical guidance when needed.
   

  

**We also believe you have:**
* A strong technical background within Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering or Data Analytics.
* Experience leading people formally or informally as an Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, Team Lead, or similar.
* An interest in coaching, mentoring, and helping others develop.
* The ability to contribute to discussions around data modelling, analytics engineering, semantic layers, data products, and modern data architectures.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
* dbt, Databricks, Spark SQL, or similar technologies.
* BI and analytics platforms.
* AI, ML, or data product environments.


**High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.**
 You’ll join a company with strong momentum, modern technology, and a collaborative culture where ideas and initiatives are encouraged.
   

  

 At Voyado, we care about creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and enjoy the journey together. We move quickly, challenge ideas, and work closely across teams to deliver meaningful impact.
   

  

**Some of our benefits:**
* 30 days of vacation
* Wellness allowance
* Personal development opportunities
* Summits and team activities
* Four days from the office and one day from home


**About Voyado**
 Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite for retail.
   

  

 More than 500 retail brands across 100 markets use Voyado to unite CRM, loyalty, product discovery, e-commerce personalization, and retail media with retail-trained AI that acts on real-time shopper intent.
   

  

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.
   

  

 We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact?
   

  

 Fantastic! 🎉
   

  

**A quick note about our recruitment timeline:** 
 As many of us will be taking some well-deserved summer vacation, this process will move a bit slower than usual.
   

  

 We’d still love to hear from you as soon as possible!
   

  

 Thank you for your understanding, and we hope you’ll apply! 🌞
   

  

 Additional information
   

  

 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.
   

  

 Making it personal with AI
   

  

 We believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.
   

  

 There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.
   

  

 In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.
   

  

 With AI-driven CRM, loyalty, e-commerce personalization, and retail media, Voyado turns every interaction - online or in-store - into lasting growth.
   

  

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.

title: IT-säkerhetsspecialist - SIEM Expert
description:
**Om tjänsten** 




 Som SIEM Expert ansvarar du för drift, förvaltning och utveckling av Svenska kraftnäts SIEM-lösning för säkerhetsövervakning. Du bidrar till att stärka säkerheten i en av Sveriges mest samhällskritiska verksamheter genom att utveckla och förbättra säkerhetsövervakningen i en komplex IT- och OT-miljö.
 



  





 Du driftar och underhåller säkerhetsövervakningsplattformen Splunk och arbetar nära plattformens användare inom Security Operations Center (SOC) samt IT-driftsorganisationen. I uppdraget ingår bland annat konfiguration och förvaltning av Splunk-kluster, Linux-administration samt utveckling av innehåll i plattformen.
 



  





**Tjänsten innebär bland annat att:** 



* Drifta, förvalta och utveckla Svenska kraftnäts SIEM-lösning för säkerhetsövervakning.
* Utveckla nya funktioner i SIEM-lösningen.
* Utveckla och förvalta datamodeller i SIEM-plattformen.
* Tillgodose SOC-analytikernas behov genom en nära dialog och ett tätt samarbete.
* Utföra drift- och förvaltningsåtgärder i SIEM-systemet.
* Arbeta tillsammans med IT-drift för att ansluta nya IT-system till SIEM-plattformen.
* Vara en del av Svenska kraftnäts team för att hantera IT-säkerhetsincidenter.Som IT-säkerhetsspecialist

title: Client Director Nordics
description:
DDN is seeking a Client Director – Strategic AI Infrastructure to drive revenue growth in the Nordics within our Artificial Intelligence business unit. This is a quota-carrying role responsible for developing strategic enterprise opportunities and expanding DDN’s presence within organizations building large-scale AI and high-performance computing environments.
   

  

 In this role, the Account Executive will operate as a Strategic AI Client Director, partnering with enterprise customers, research institutions, and cloud organizations to deliver high-performance data infrastructure solutions that support advanced AI workloads.
   

  

 The successful candidate will work closely with internal engineering teams, solutions architects, and channel partners to design and deliver complex AI infrastructure solutions supporting GPU computing, large-scale model training, and data-intensive workloads.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as a Strategic AI Client Director within the assigned Nordics region, driving adoption of DDN’s AI infrastructure solutions across enterprise and research organizations.
* Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans targeting organizations building large-scale AI and high-performance computing environments.
* Identify and qualify new opportunities across industries including financial services, healthcare, telecommunications, technology, research institutions, and large enterprise organizations.
* Build trusted relationships with senior technical leaders, AI infrastructure teams, and executive decision-makers within target accounts.
* Partner with solutions architects and engineering teams to design and present AI infrastructure and high-performance data storage solutions.
* Deliver compelling presentations, product demonstrations, and proposals showcasing the value of DDN’s AI-optimized storage platforms.
* Manage the full enterprise sales cycle including pipeline development, forecasting, contract negotiation, and deal closure.
* Develop strong relationships with channel partners, system integrators, OEM partners, and distributors to expand market reach.
* Stay current on market trends related to AI infrastructure, GPU computing, large-scale model training, and high-performance data environments.
* Represent DDN at industry events, conferences, and customer engagements to generate new opportunities and strengthen market presence.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 8+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, preferably within storage, compute, networking, or infrastructure platforms.
* Demonstrated experience selling AI infrastructure, HPC solutions, cloud platforms, or enterprise data center technologies.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas in enterprise technology environments.
* Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving technical buyers and executive stakeholders.
* Ability to travel within the East Coast territory as needed.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience selling AI infrastructure, GPU clusters, or high-performance computing platforms.
* Familiarity with the AI ecosystem including technologies from NVIDIA, Intel, AMD, Cerebras, Graphcore, or Google TPU.
* Knowledge of enterprise storage technologies including SAN, NAS, object storage, and parallel file systems.
* Experience working with channel partners, system integrators, and distributor ecosystems.
* Familiarity with technologies such as Kubernetes, OpenStack, and large-scale AI data center environments.


**Why Join DDN**
 At DDN, you will work at the forefront of AI infrastructure innovation, helping organizations solve some of the most demanding data challenges in the world. Our teams collaborate across engineering, sales, and customer success to deliver cutting-edge technology that powers the next generation of AI breakthroughs.

title: Head of Data
description:
*Genom snabb och säker digital identifiering möjliggör vi ett modernt och tillgängligt samhälle.* 




  





 Finansiell ID-Teknik är företaget bakom BankID, Sveriges mest använda lösning för digital identifiering och underskrift. Idag använder över 8 miljoner svenskar BankID och flertalet myndigheter, banker och andra företag har BankID i sina e-tjänster. Vår ledstjärna är säkerhet och i alla lägen säkrar vi användarnas identitet och integritet. Vi är en liten organisation med stor kompetens och ett samhällsviktigt uppdrag. Här jobbar vi nära tillsammans för att tillhandahålla säker, snabb och tillgänglig digital identifiering och underskrift till det svenska samhället.
 



  





**Om tjänsten** 




  





 Som Head of Data har du ansvaret för bolagets strategi och roadmap för området data. Du säkerställer att data används som en strategisk tillgång i hela organisationen, på ett säkert, kontrollerat och skalbart sätt.
 



  





 Du leder och utvecklar ett team inom ”data engineering” och databashantering. Du ingår i bolagets tekniska ledningsgrupp. I nära samarbete med Analytics, Security, Legal, Compliance och Product säkerställer du att datahanteringen möter både affärens behov och regulatoriska krav.
 



  





 Du rapporterar till CTO.
 



  





**Är det här du?** 




  





 För att lyckas i rollen som Head of Data har du relevant akademisk utbildning och gedigen erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla dataorganisationer i komplexa och reglerade miljöer. Du har flera års erfarenhet inom dataområdet, varav minst några i en ledande roll, och är van att ta ett helhetsansvar för strategi, struktur och leverans.
 



  





 Du har god förståelse för regulatoriska ramverk som exempelvis GDPR och DORA.
 



 Tekniskt har du erfarenhet av modern dataarkitektur, dataplattformar i stor skala, relationsdatabaser och data warehouse‑lösningar. Du har arbetat med både miljöer ”on‑prem” och molnplattformar. Erfarenhet av AI/ML‑arkitektur är meriterande.
 



  





 Som ledare är du tydlig, strukturerad och kommunikativ. Du kan förmedla komplexa data‑ och teknikfrågor på ett begripligt sätt till både tekniska och icke‑tekniska intressenter.
 



 Vi fäster stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och söker dig som är trygg i ditt ledarskap, samarbetsorienterad och prestigelös.
 



  





**Om BankID** 




  





 Vi är ett ”Great place to work”-certifierat bolag. ”Great Place to work” definierar en utmärkt arbetsplats så här: ”En utmärkt arbetsplats är en där man litar på människorna man arbetar för, känner stolthet för det man gör och trivs med människorna man jobbar tillsammans med.”
 



  





**Vill du veta mer?** 




  





 I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Level Recruitment. Sök tjänsten genom att klicka på "ansök"-knappen här intill. Vid frågor vänligen kontakta Lynn Sjöberg Westander, Senior Rekryteringskonsult, på 08-120 50 431. Urvalet av ansökningar sker löpande. Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Chief Engineer
description:
We are looking for a **Chief Engineer (STCW A-III/2, unlimited)** to join our team, starting in the shipyard where our new vessel is being built.

* The required starting date would be **October 2026** in the shipyard in Vigo, Spain.
* Our new vessel will be a 75m Sailing (DynaRig system) special-purpose, Ice class PC7 vessel, propulsion: two E-Motors, dual-prop (CPP) driven, powered by 4 pcs dual-fuel (MeOH and MGO) engines, 4 pcs FC (fuel cells) run on compressed H2, Battery pack with the ability to recharge from props (regeneration), solar panels, all connected on DC bus and water cooled. The vessel is Dutch flagged and is maintained in DNV class, subject to regular surveys and inspections.
* The vessel delivery is planned for October 2027

**In this role you will, amongst other things**


During your time in the shipyard:

* Monitor the building of the new vessel in collaboration with the GP hired supervision team of OSM Thome.
* Attend meetings with shipyard, site and remote teams on the new build progress.
* Familiarise yourself with the new ship systems and assist in the planned maintenance system for the new build.

**Onboard our vessels:**


Responsible to the Master for:

* Safe operation and maintenance of engine plant and equipment.
* Follow the Safety Management System of Greenpeace.
* Safe watch keeping of engine plant and equipment at sea and in port in accordance with STCW Ch VIII.
* Safe operation and maintenance of all mechanical and electrical equipment outside the engine room.
* Supervising the maintenance of rigid hull inflatable boats (rhibs) and outboard engines and ensuring technical readiness of rhibs for Campaigns.
* Supervising the work of all engine staff including out board mechanics and fitter / welder.
* Set-up of engine room watches at sea and in port.
* Issue clear Standing Instructions to engine staff for watch keeping, bunkering, and emergency engine procedures.
* Implement Master’s instructions on safe working practice and shipboard environmental policy in the engine room.
* Ensuring that there are no illegal discharges of oil, garbage, sewage from the engine room in contravention of the MARPOL Convention as amended.
* Ensuring that the Oil record Book is properly maintained as per the instructions contained therein.
* Ensuring that the Oily Water Separator (OWS) and Oil Detection Monitor (ODM) where fitted are regularly tested and any illegal connections immediately removed and reported to the Master and Technical Manager.
* Ensures that the fleet management software where provided is regularly updated for planned maintenance, inventory control, spare and


consumable requisitions.

* Ensure that required spares are requisitioned in time and followed up with the Technical Manager.
* Maintain engine logbooks and produce monthly reports to the Technical Manager.
* Assign work and responsibilities to the engine room staff.
* Ensuring that machinery which is not in regular use are periodically tested and maintained.
* Confer with the Technical Manager regarding procedures and policies for the engine room and all other equipment.
* Advise the Master on arrival of the condition of all equipment and to confer with the Technical Manager on priorities of work in port.
* Confer with the Master daily when at sea and report any deficiencies immediately.
* Maintain accountability and logbooks of all mechanical and electrical spares, fuel/water levels and spares used.
* Provide a written report each month or at the end of the voyage, whichever precedes, and cover general performance of the engine room and equipment; any problem areas and any recommendation for replacement / maintenance / additional equipment.
* Adhere strictly to bunker procedures, which should be prominently displayed and record pre bunker meetings in the Engine log book.
* Request Master to post deck personnel temporarily to the engine room when required.
* Before entry and departure port all engine controls are tested and records of tests entered in the engine log book
* Participate in Campaigns and training.

  

What we’re looking for:

* Valid STCW certificates for a Chief Engineer **(STCW A-III/2, unlimited)**
* Desirable to have experience with methanol / LFL fuel, IGF Code certified.
* Desirable to have previous experience in a shipyard for vessel take over.
* A long term team player with good interpersonal skills that can work with a set of diverse crew.
* Support for and belief in the Greenpeace core aims and values.

 **About us:**

 *Greenpeace is a global campaigning network. It comprises 25 independent national/regional organisations, and a coordinating organisation, Greenpeace International. Greenpeace uses peaceful, creative confrontation to expose global environmental problems, and develop solutions for a green and peaceful future.*


Our goal is to ensure the ability of the earth to nurture life in all its diversity. That means we want to:

* protect biodiversity in all its forms
* prevent pollution and abuse of the earth’s ocean, land, air and fresh water
* end all nuclear threats
* promote peace, global disarmament and non-violence

**To Apply**


If you share our vision, please click 'apply’ at the top of this page to begin your application and upload your CV (in English) via our online application form.


If you have any questions about this vacancy or the application process, please email us at: crewing.int@greenpeace.org.


Please note that all applications have to be filled out via the website and can't be submitted via this email.


We look forward to sailing with you!

title: Senior/Lead Quality Engineer - Chatbot
description:
**What we are building**
------------------------


Mimica's mission is to empower enterprises, teams, and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource — time and work more efficiently, with greater purpose and impact.


Our AI-powered task mining observes employee actions across the desktop and categorizes them into detailed process maps. Mimica’s process intelligence highlights inefficiencies, prioritizes improvements based on ROI, recommends the optimal technology for automation (RPA, intelligent document processing, GenAI), and provides a blueprint for building new automations and transforming work.


Visit our Career Page to learn more.

**Your mission**
----------------


We are looking for a Quality Engineer to help us build a faster, and more reliable testing and release processes for one of our latest product engineering teams. You will work closely with Software and Machine Learning Engineers to establish the quality foundations for a product characterised by dynamic, non-deterministic outputs.


The team is a newly formed multidisciplinary team of 5 responsible for the conversational AI components across our WebApp. As the team’s founding Quality Engineer, you will play a central role in defining how we approach quality from the outset. You will introduce thoughtful, pragmatic practices that increase confidence in releases, reduce remediation and rollback work, and enable the team to move quickly without compromising user trust or product reliability.


You will have meaningful ownership from day one: exploring testing approaches, identifying quality gaps, and helping shape the systems and processes that support sustainable delivery. This is an opportunity for someone who thrives in ambiguity, combines hands-on technical testing with experimentation, and wants to define quality engineering at the intersection of software development and LLM-powered products.

**Part of your day-to-day**
---------------------------

* Develop and evolve quality practices, test strategy, and release processes for the Chatbot product.
* Help establish and run an output-evaluation framework for assessing Chatbot quality, reliability, and regressions.
* Test dynamic and non-deterministic LLM-based systems, designing pragmatic approaches for validating behaviour beyond conventional deterministic test cases.
* Identify, test, and improve guardrails for AI-specific risks, including prompt-injection scenarios and unsafe or unexpected model behaviour.
* Partner with engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and collaborative debugging to improve quality earlier in the development lifecycle.
* Investigate current testing gaps, research relevant methods and tools, and make evidence-based recommendations to the team.
* Design proof-of-concepts for new testing approaches or tooling, then help productionise the solutions that create the most value.
* Support the evolution of release testing, including clearer quality signals and release-readiness criteria.
* Contribute performance-testing thinking for LLM-powered workflows where relevant.
* Share knowledge, facilitate technical discussions, and build the Quality Chapter across the wider engineering organisation.

**Requirements / What we’re looking for**
-----------------------------------------

* Strong hands-on experience in software quality engineering, SDET, test automation, or a closely related engineering role.
* **Experience testing chatbot, conversational AI, RAG, LLM-powered**, or other systems with **dynamic and non-deterministic** behaviour; even early practical exposure is valuable.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language and enough technical depth to understand production code, contribute to code reviews, and collaborate effectively with software engineers.
* An experimental, investigative mindset: you can explore an uncertain problem space, assess alternatives, and turn findings into practical improvements.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical concepts, testing risks, design choices, and trade-offs.
* Strong collaboration skills and a pragmatic approach to working with Product, Engineering, and ML colleagues.
* Good judgement in prioritising quality work based on risk, user impact, and delivery goals.

  

**Bonus / Nice to have**
------------------------

* Experience with AI security and safety testing.
* Experience testing conversational AI, chatbot platforms, or agentic workflows.
* Experience as the first Quality Engineer in a team.
* Experience mentoring engineers or influencing testing practices across a cross-functional team.
* Keeps pace with industry developments and actively fosters knowledge sharing by bringing new tech trends and methodology back to the team

**Hiring Process**
------------------

  

Stage 1 | Recruiter Screen (30 mins)


Stage 2 | HM Interview (45 mins)


Stage 3 | Take-home + Live Follow-up (60 mins) with members from the Chatbot team + Quality Chapter.


Stage 4 | Behavioral Interview (60 mins) with Co-founder/CTO + Lead Quality Engineer

**Location**
------------


This is a fully remote position. You can be based anywhere in the **UK**, **Americas, or Europe within a UTC-5 to UTC+1 timezone.**

**What we offer**
-----------------


Generous compensation + stock options - aligned with our internal framework, market data, and individual skills.


Distributed work: Work from anywhere - fully remote, in our hubs, or a mix.


Company-issued laptop, remote setup stipend, and co-working budget


Flexible schedules and location


Ample paid time off, in addition to local public holidays


Enhanced parental leave


Health & retirement benefits


Annual learning & development budget


Annual workaways and regular virtual & in-person socials


Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of work

***Note****: Some benefits may vary depending on location and role*


 Mimica will only contact candidates from an @mimica.ai email address. We do not request banking or sensitive personal information during the recruiting process.

title: Field Support Professional - 2
description:
**Job Description:**

**Field Service Engineer**

  

At ESAB, innovation has been driving our business for more than 100 years. Today, we continue to develop advanced welding and cutting solutions that help shape the future of manufacturing worldwide.

 *North England*

  

The **Field Service Engineer** plays a critical role in supporting several key areas of our business. Installing and repairing our product fleet is an important part of the role, but it is far from our only expectation. Building relationships with key customers—so you become a trusted adviser—and leveraging that position is one of the most profitable opportunities in our welding automation business. We view the AM Field Service function as a key technical and commercial asset, working in close cooperation with our Sales teams.

 **Duties & Responsibilities:**

*Safety Responsibilities:*

* Follow all safety protocols during daily operations.
* Actively promote a strong safety culture and drive safety improvement initiatives.

 *Key Technical Responsibilities:*

* Respect ESAB’s protocols and procedures always
* Maintain consistent availability and responsiveness to management and customer communications, including timely participation in scheduled meetings, trainings, and service coordination calls.
* Take ownership of proactive planning and maintain a full schedule of service activities in coordination with the Field Service Manager and customers.

title: Postdoc in Human-in-the-loop Software Engineering for Secure Software Supply Chains
description:
We are offering a postdoc position in an exciting national project focusing on software security, with great opportunities for collaborations with top researchers in cybersecurity, program analysis, and software engineering. The position is salaried (not just fully funded) and part of a lively research environment located in the beautiful city of Gothenburg on the West coast of Sweden.



The position is part of the ShiftLeft project funded by WASP, a flagship project with partner universities at KTH, Linköping, and Umeå.


**About us**
------------



The Department of Computer Science and Engineering, a joint department of Chalmers and the University of Gothenburg, spans the breadth of computing disciplines. Our internationally visible research, strong industry links and diverse environment create a collaborative setting where ideas grow into real impact.



At the division of Interaction Design and Software Engineering, we design smarter ways to engineer better software, and explore how people engage with digital systems, combining global research perspectives with strong collaboration with industry.


**About the research project**
------------------------------



Software is often the root cause of vulnerabilities in modern computing systems. By focusing on securing the software, we target principled security mechanisms that provide robust protection against large classes of attacks. Modern software applications are almost never built from scratch but reuse a significant amount of code that has been built by 3rd parties. These code artifacts, in the form of externally developed libraries, packages, and frameworks form the core of their so-called software supply chain. The goal of ShiftLeft is to contribute to a new paradigm shift for securing software supply chains.



As a postdoc in the project, you will focus on human-in-the-loop aspects of a self-adaptive security analysis platform. The platform performs static and dynamic security analysis. The idea is that not all analysis results shall be displayed the same way all the time, but different vulnerabilities and analysis results will be more or less relevant in different situations. Some of the questions you will be able to address as part of your postdoc are: (i) how can an adaptive human-in-the-loop layer be designed that dynamically adjusts what security analysis results are displayed, depending on the context?, (ii) what human and contextual factors are relevant to consider (e.g., experience of the developer, stress, expectations, …)?, and (iii) how can relevant factors be formally modelled and used to adapt the displayed analysis results? The successful applicant will be encouraged to collaborate with PhD students and postdocs working on related topics in the ShiftLeft project and be involved in supervision.



The position is partially funded by WASP. Wallenberg AI, Autonomous Systems and Software Program (WASP) is Sweden’s largest individual research program ever, a major national initiative for strategically motivated basic research, education and faculty recruitment. The program addresses research on artificial intelligence and autonomous systems acting in collaboration with humans, adapting to their environment through sensors, information and knowledge, and forming intelligent systems-of-systems. The vision of WASP is excellent research and competence in artificial intelligence, autonomous systems and software for the benefit of Swedish society and industry. Read more: https://wasp-sweden.org/


**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------


#### ***The following requirements are mandatory:***


* A doctoral degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or an equivalent foreign degree. This eligibility requirement must be met no later than the time the employment decision is made
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* You are highly motivated, energetic, independent, and have well-developed analytical problem-solving ability
* A well-documented track record of research interests and achievements in an area strongly related to the project


You are expected to be somewhat accustomed to teaching, and to demonstrate good potential within research and education.


***The following experience will strengthen your application:***


* It is highly meritorious if the doctoral degree has been obtained within the last three years prior to the application deadline

**What you will do**
--------------------


* Perform research studies and publish in top conferences and journals
* Supervise master’s and/or PhD students to a certain extent
* Possibility to engage in teaching at undergraduate/master’s level


The position is meritorious for future roles in academia, industry, or the public sector.


**Contract terms**
------------------



The position is a temporary full-time employment for two years with the possibility of a one-year extension.



The position requires physical presence throughout the entire employment. A valid residence permit must be presented by the start date, otherwise the offer may be withdrawn.


**What we offer**
-----------------


* As a postdoc at Chalmers, you are an employee and enjoy all employee benefits. Read more about working at Chalmers and our benefits for employees.
* A dynamic and inspiring working environment in the coastal city of Gothenburg.
* Read more about Sweden’s generous parental leave, subsidized day care, free schools, healthcare etc at Move To Gothenburg.


Chalmers is dedicated to improving gender balance and actively works with equality projects, such as the GENIE Initiative for gender equality and excellence. We celebrate diversity and consider equality and inclusion as fundamental aspects of all our activities.



If Swedish is not your native language, Chalmers offers Swedish courses to help you settle in.


**Application procedure**
-------------------------


*The application should be written in English be attached as PDF-files, as below. Maximum size for each file is 40 MB. Please note that the system does not support Zip files.*


#### **CV**


* A comprehensive CV, including a complete list of publications.
* Details of previous teaching and pedagogical experience.
* Names and contact details of at least two reference persons that we can contact. If you include letters of recommendation, that strengthens your application.

#### **Personal letter** **(maximum one A4 page)**


* A brief introduction about yourself.
* A summary of your previous research track record.
* An outline of your future goals and research interests.


Use the button at the foot of the page to reach the application form.  

  

A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.  

  

**Please note:** The applicant is responsible for ensuring that the application is complete. Incomplete applications and applications sent by email will not be considered. Contact details to references will be requested after the interview.


**We welcome your application no later than September 15, 2026.**


#### **For questions please contact:**



Rebekka Wohlrab  

Associate Professor  

wohlrab@chalmers.se


### **We look forward to your application!**

The university has 3100 employees and 10,000 students, and offers education in engineering, science, shipping and architecture. With scientific excellence as a basis, Chalmers promotes knowledge and technical solutions for a sustainable world. By joining our company, you have an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of next-generation cloud services. We are seeking intellectually curious and highly motivated team members who are ready to embrace the thrilling challenge of building the first European owned hyperscale cloud.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Stockholm
   

  

**Job type:** 
 Permanent position
   

  

**Join the Pioneers**
 We’re looking for a Software Engineer to build the core of evroc’s Billing Platform, a system that processes millions of events and powers usage-based pricing, invoicing, and revenue flows across our cloud.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role across backend engineering and data engineering. You will own the full lifecycle of billing data, from ingestion and processing to storage and reconciliation, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and scalability across both real-time and batch systems.
   

  

 You’ll work on the systems that ensure that every usage event is captured, transformed, and reflected correctly in billing, at scale, and with zero tolerance for errors.
   

  

**What You’ll Tackle**
* Design and build end-to-end billing data pipelines, from event ingestion to analytical storage.
* Develop backend services and APIs handling validation, processing, and billing logic in distributed systems.
* Implement event-driven architectures with strong guarantees around idempotency and financial consistency.
* Design data models and storage strategies that support both high-throughput ingestion and efficient querying.
* Build data processing jobs that enrich usage data with pricing, entitlements, and cost calculations.
* Implement reconciliation and validation mechanisms to ensure data accuracy across systems.
* Integrate billing systems with external financial platforms such as payment providers and accounting systems.
* Build observability into pipelines and services, ensuring visibility into data freshness, throughput, and correctness.


**Skills We Value**
* 5+ years of experience in backend engineering and/or data engineering within complex systems.
* Strong experience with Golang and building distributed, event-driven systems.
* Experience working with message buses such as Kafka, Pub/Sub or similar.
* Hands-on experience with data processing frameworks and building ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Strong database knowledge across both relational and NoSQL systems, and understanding of consistency trade-offs.
* Experience designing data models and handling schema evolution in large-scale systems.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Understanding of financial systems, billing, or accounting principles is a strong plus.


**Why Join evroc?**
 We offer a competitive salary and an equity package to attract the best. Whether it’s the cosmopolitan allure of London, the vibrant Stockholm, or the Mediterranean charm of Sophia Antipolis, you’re poised for an inspiring work environment and a captivating local culture!
